```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LEGEND NUMBERS — helper
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Every panel below writes the sample sizes and test details its legend needs
# to the console AND to one text file, so the legend can be checked against a
# single readout. The file is overwritten each time the notebook is run.
LEGEND_FILE <- "Figure1_legend_numbers.txt"
cat("Figure 1 / Supplementary Figure 1 — legend numbers\n",
    "Generated: ", format(Sys.time()), "\n", file = LEGEND_FILE, sep = "")

legend_out <- function(title, x = NULL) {
  body <- if (is.null(x)) character(0)
          else if (is.character(x)) x
          else utils::capture.output(print(as.data.frame(x), row.names = FALSE))
  txt <- c("", paste0("=== ", title, " ==="), body)
  cat(txt, sep = "\n")
  cat(txt, sep = "\n", file = LEGEND_FILE, append = TRUE)
  invisible(NULL)
}

# n samples / n infants for a data frame, optionally by group
n_si <- function(df, ..., id = "MM_ID") {
  df %>% dplyr::group_by(...) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_samples = dplyr::n(),
                     n_infants = dplyr::n_distinct(.data[[id]]), .groups = "drop")
}
```

```{r}
# Load the data
metadata <- read.table("meta_with_placental_subtypes.txt", header = TRUE, quote = "\"", na.strings = c("NA", ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, comment.char = "")

metadata_selected<-metadata%>% select (ID, MM_ID, Postnatal_Age, mmpercentage, family_group, multiple, placental_weight)
write.table(metadata_selected, "metadata_selected.txt",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

taxa_cleaned <- read.delim("taxa_cleaned_jan.txt")
row.names(taxa_cleaned)<-taxa_cleaned$ID
taxa_cleaned$ID=NULL
row.names(metadata)<-metadata$ID
metadata_infant <- metadata[grep("^B", rownames(metadata)), ]
taxa_infant <- taxa_cleaned[grep("^B", rownames(taxa_cleaned)), ]

# Factors (categorical/binary variables)
factor_vars <- c("prolonged_rupt", "surgery", "ab48", "multiple", "delivery_md",
                 "maternal_atb", "mother_st_com", "placenta_ab", "pe_hellp",
                 "maternal_infect", "mother_b_hem", "nec",
                 "sex", "sip", "sepsis_culture", "pda_sign", "mortality",
                 "pda", "probiotics", "SGA", "LGA", "FGR", "ivh", "abtx")

# Numeric (continuous variables)
numeric_vars <- c("mmpercentage", "probiotic_sample","apgar_1", "apgar_5", "antibiotic_sample", "ga_exact", "bw", "admissiontime", "tpn_days", "TFEF_B", "TFEF", "DNA_conc","Clean_reads_P1", "week", "Postnatal_Age", "MM_ID" )

# Apply to dataframe
metadata_infant[factor_vars] <- lapply(metadata_infant[factor_vars], as.factor)
metadata_infant[numeric_vars] <- lapply(metadata_infant[numeric_vars], as.numeric)

# Verify
str(metadata_infant[, c(factor_vars, numeric_vars)])

taxa=taxa_infant[row.names(taxa_infant)%in% rownames(metadata_infant),] # Only taxa present in infants 
setdiff (rownames(taxa), rownames(metadata_infant)) # all good 

taxa_sp=taxa
taxa_sp=taxa_sp[,grep("s__",colnames(taxa_sp))]
taxa_sp=taxa_sp[,-grep("t__",colnames(taxa_sp))]
taxa_sub_species<-taxa[,grep("t__",colnames(taxa))]

taxa_genus=taxa
taxa_genus=taxa_genus[,grep("g__",colnames(taxa_genus))]
taxa_genus=taxa_genus[,-grep("s__",colnames(taxa_genus))]

#Simplify names
colnames(taxa_sp)=gsub(".*s__","",colnames(taxa_sp))
colnames(taxa_sub_species)=gsub(".*t__","",colnames(taxa_sub_species))
colnames(taxa_genus)=gsub(".*g__","",colnames(taxa_genus))

#taxa_sp$Bifidobacterium_longum=NULL
#taxa_sp$Bifidobacterium_animalis=NULL
#taxa_sp$Streptococcus_thermophilus=NULL

taxa_sp <- taxa_sp %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(.)))
taxa_sub_species <- taxa_sub_species %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(.)))

richness <- plyr::ddply(taxa_sp,~rownames(taxa_sp),function(x) {
  data.frame(RICHNESS=sum(x[-1]>0, na.rm = T))})
row.names(richness)<-richness$`rownames(taxa_sp)`
richness$`rownames(taxa_sp)`=NULL
my_alpha_diversity=data.frame(Shannon=diversity(taxa_sp, index = "shannon"), Simpson=diversity(taxa_sp, index = "simpson"))
my_alpha_diversity=merge(my_alpha_diversity, richness, by="row.names")
row.names(my_alpha_diversity)=my_alpha_diversity$Row.names
my_alpha_diversity$Row.names=NULL

phenos_imputed_div=merge(my_alpha_diversity, metadata_infant, by="row.names")
row.names(phenos_imputed_div)=phenos_imputed_div$Row.names
phenos_imputed_div$Row.names=NULL

taxa_sp$ID<-row.names(taxa_sp)
taxa_sp$personal_ID<-sub ("_.*",  "",  taxa_sp$ID)
unique_counts <- sapply(taxa_sp, function(x) length(unique(taxa_sp$personal_ID[x >0.05]))) 
taxa_sp_filt <- taxa_sp[, unique_counts >= 1]  
taxa_sp_filt$personal_ID=NULL
taxa_sp_filt$ID=NULL

#CLR Transformations
my_pseudocount_normal=min(taxa_sp_filt[taxa_sp_filt!=0])/2

# Align the taxa table to the phenotype table by row name.
stopifnot(setequal(row.names(taxa_sp_filt), row.names(phenos_imputed_div)))
taxa_sp_filt <- taxa_sp_filt[row.names(phenos_imputed_div), , drop = FALSE]
my_distance_CLR=vegdist(taxa_sp_filt, method = "aitchison", pseudocount=my_pseudocount_normal) 
taxa_sp_filt_CLR <- decostand(taxa_sp_filt, "clr", pseudocount=my_pseudocount_normal)
mypcoa_CLR=cmdscale(my_distance_CLR, k = 20, eig = T)
my_var_CLR=round(mypcoa_CLR$eig*100/sum(mypcoa_CLR$eig),2)[1:20]
barplot (my_var_CLR)
mypcoa_df_CLR=as.data.frame(mypcoa_CLR$points)
names(mypcoa_df_CLR) <- c('PC1','PC2','PC3','PC4','PC5', 'PC6','PC7','PC8','PC9','PC10',
                          'PC11','PC12','PC13','PC14','PC15', 'PC16','PC17','PC18','PC19','PC20')
phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR=merge(mypcoa_df_CLR,phenos_imputed_div, by="row.names")
row.names (phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR)<-phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR$Row.names

# ── LEGEND NUMBERS: cohort overview (Fig. 1a) and analysed sample set ─────────
# Infant samples are selected here by the "^B" ID prefix and elsewhere by
# SampleType == "infant"; the two definitions are checked against each other.
meta_check <- read.table("meta_with_placental_subtypes.txt", header = TRUE,
                         quote = "\"", na.strings = c("NA", ""),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE, comment.char = "")
by_prefix <- meta_check$ID[grepl("^B", meta_check$ID)]
by_type   <- meta_check$ID[meta_check$SampleType == "infant"]
legend_out("Infant definition check: '^B' prefix vs SampleType == 'infant'",
           sprintf("prefix: %d | SampleType: %d | identical sets: %s",
                   length(by_prefix), length(by_type),
                   setequal(by_prefix, by_type)))

legend_out("Fig 1a — sample types in metadata (samples; distinct MM_ID)",
           meta_check %>% n_si(SampleType))

cohort <- phenos_imputed_div %>% mutate(MM_ID = as.numeric(MM_ID))
legend_out("Fig 1a / Fig 1c / Supp 1 — infant samples with metagenomes (total)",
           cohort %>% n_si())
legend_out("Fig 1a — per postnatal week",
           cohort %>% n_si(week))
legend_out("Fig 1a — samples per infant (median [IQR], range)",
           {s <- table(cohort$MM_ID)
            sprintf("median %g [IQR %g–%g], range %d–%d",
                    median(s), quantile(s, .25), quantile(s, .75), min(s), max(s))})
legend_out("Fig 1a — infants ever / never exposed to probiotics",
           cohort %>% dplyr::group_by(MM_ID) %>%
             dplyr::summarise(ever = any(probiotics == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                              never = all(probiotics == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                              .groups = "drop") %>%
             dplyr::summarise(infants = dplyr::n(), ever_exposed = sum(ever),
                              never_exposed = sum(never)))
legend_out("Fig 1a — per probiotic status at sampling (samples; infants)",
           cohort %>% n_si(probiotics))
```

```{r}

# 1B Beta Diversity & PERMANOVA Analysis

library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)

META_FILE <- "meta_with_placental_subtypes.txt"

# plyr / plotly / lmerTest mask dplyr verbs — pin them
select    <- dplyr::select
filter    <- dplyr::filter
mutate    <- dplyr::mutate
summarise <- dplyr::summarise
arrange   <- dplyr::arrange
rename    <- dplyr::rename
group_by  <- dplyr::group_by

# ── Screening thresholds ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
MIN_LEVEL_INFANTS  <- 5      # distinct infants required in EACH level, per week
MIN_TOTAL_INFANTS  <- 10     # distinct infants required for a continuous phenotype
MAX_MAJORITY_SHARE <- 0.95   # largest level may hold at most this share of infants
                             # (equivalent to the reference's minimum_variance = 5)
MIN_SAMPLES_WEEK   <- 10     # minimum samples for a week to be analysed at all

# Declared factor level that never occurs within a given week:
#   "drop_level"  -> remove it, test the remaining levels that week
#   "drop_factor" -> do not test the factor that week
EMPTY_LEVEL_ACTION <- "drop_level"

# Some infants contribute two samples in the same week, which PERMANOVA treats
# as independent observations. Set TRUE to keep one sample per infant per week
# (the earliest by Postnatal_Age) as a sensitivity analysis.
ONE_SAMPLE_PER_INFANT_PER_WEEK <- FALSE

# ── Distance construction ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BUILD_DISTANCE   <- TRUE   # FALSE = use an existing my_distance_CLR unchanged
PREV_ABUNDANCE   <- 0.05   # a taxon counts as present in an infant above this
MIN_PREV_INFANTS <- 1      # taxon kept if present in at least this many infants

INFANT_ID <- "MM_ID"   # counting unit for the screens
SAMPLE_ID <- "ID"      # row key, matches the distance matrix

print_all <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) { cat("  (none)\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  print(as.data.frame(df), row.names = FALSE)
  invisible(NULL)
}

# ── Phenotypes to test ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PHENOS_TO_TEST <- c(
  "prolonged_rupt", "mmpercentage", "surgery", "ab48", "apgar_1",
  "apgar_5", "multiple", "delivery_md", "maternal_atb", "mother_st_com",
  "pe_hellp", "maternal_infect", "mother_b_hem",
  "antibiotic_sample", "ga_exact", "bw", "nec",
  "sex", "admissiontime", "tpn_days", "sip", "sepsis_culture",
  "pda_sign", "mortality", "pda", "SGA",
  "LGA", "FGR", "TFEF_B", "TFEF", "ivh", "abtx",
  "probiotics", "probiotic_sample",   # the export spells this "probiotic_sample"
  # ── placental pathology: subtype factors + hypoplasia ─────────────────────
  # placenta_ab and placental_weight are dropped, same as the binary version.
  # dvi/chiv/mfi/mpvfd are omitted: all-zero in the current export.
  "mvm", "fh", "hypoplasia", "fvm_type", "ch_type", "ca_type", "vue_type"
)
# "week" is deliberately absent: it is the stratifier, so it is constant within
# each subset and cannot be tested there.

PHENOTYPE_LABELS <- c(
  # ── maternal / obstetric ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "prolonged_rupt"    = "Prolonged Rupture of Membranes",
  "multiple"          = "Multiple Pregnancy",
  "delivery_md"       = "Delivery Mode",
  "maternal_atb"      = "Maternal Antibiotics",
  "maternal_ab48"     = "Maternal Antibiotics (48h)",
  "mother_st"         = "Antenatal Corticosteroids (any)",
  "mother_st_com"     = "Antenatal Corticosteroids (complete)",
  "pe_hellp"          = "Pre-eclampsia / HELLP",
  "maternal_infect"   = "Maternal Infection",
  "mother_b_hem"      = "Maternal Group B Streptococcus",
  "primiparous"       = "Primiparous",
  "parities_nb"       = "Parity",

  # ── infant characteristics ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "ga_exact"          = "Gestational Age",
  "bw"                = "Birth Weight",
  "sex"               = "Sex",
  "apgar_1"           = "Apgar Score (1 min)",
  "apgar_5"           = "Apgar Score (5 min)",
  "SGA"               = "Small for Gestational Age",
  "LGA"               = "Large for Gestational Age",
  "FGR"               = "Fetal Growth Restriction",
  "admissiontime"     = "Admission Duration",
  "week"              = "Postnatal Week",
  "Postnatal_Age"     = "Postnatal Age",

  # ── treatment / exposure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "ab48"              = "Antibiotics in First 48h",
  "abtx"              = "Antibiotic Treatment",
  "antibiotic_sample" = "Days of Antibiotic Use",
  "antibiotic"        = "Days of Antibiotic Use",
  "probiotics"        = "Probiotics",
  "probiotic_sample"  = "Days of Probiotic Use",
  "probiotics_sample" = "Days of Probiotic Use",
  "tpn_days"          = "Duration of Parenteral Nutrition",
  "TFEF"              = "Time to Full Enteral Feeds",
  "TFEF_B"            = "Time to Full Enteral Feeds (dichotomised)",
  "mmpercentage"      = "Mother's Own Milk (%)",
  "surgery"           = "Surgery",
  "surgery_nec"       = "Surgery for NEC",
  "rbc_tx_48"         = "Red Cell Transfusion (48h)",

  # ── outcomes / morbidity ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "nec"               = "Necrotizing Enterocolitis",
  "nec_bell"          = "NEC (Bell Stage)",
  "sip"               = "Spontaneous Intestinal Perforation",
  "sepsis"            = "Sepsis",
  "sepsis_culture"    = "Culture-proven Sepsis",
  "sepsis_crp"        = "Sepsis (CRP-defined)",
  "pda"               = "Patent Ductus Arteriosus",
  "pda_sign"          = "Haemodynamically Significant PDA",
  "ivh"               = "Intraventricular Haemorrhage",
  "mortality"         = "Mortality",

  # ── placental pathology ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "mvm"               = "Maternal Vascular Malperfusion",
  "fvm"               = "Fetal Vascular Malperfusion",
  "fh"                = "Increased Nucleated Fetal Erythrocytes",
  "hypoplasia"        = "Placental Hypoplasia (weight <p10)",
  "placenta_ab"       = "Any Placental Abnormality",
  "placental_weight"  = "Placental Weight",
  "fvm_high_grade"    = "Fetal Vascular Malperfusion (High Grade)",
  "vue_high_grade"    = "Villitis of Unknown Aetiology (High Grade)",
  "fvm_type"          = "Fetal Vascular Malperfusion",
  "ch_type"           = "Chorangiosis",
  "ca_type"           = "Chorioamnionitis",
  "vue_type"          = "Villitis of Unknown Aetiology"
)

LEVEL_LABELS <- c(
  "low grade"                   = "Low Grade",
  "high grade"                  = "High Grade",
  "segmental"                   = "Segmental",
  "diffuse"                     = "Diffuse",
  "maternal response only"      = "Maternal Response Only",
  "maternal and fetal response" = "Maternal and Fetal Response"
)

clean_phenotype_name <- function(name) {
  vapply(name, function(nm) {
    if (nm %in% names(PHENOTYPE_LABELS)) return(unname(PHENOTYPE_LABELS[nm]))
    if (grepl("__", nm, fixed = TRUE)) {
      parts <- strsplit(nm, "__", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      base  <- parts[1]; lvl <- paste(parts[-1], collapse = "__")
      base_lab <- if (base %in% names(PHENOTYPE_LABELS))
        unname(PHENOTYPE_LABELS[base]) else tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", base))
      lvl_lab  <- if (lvl %in% names(LEVEL_LABELS))
        unname(LEVEL_LABELS[lvl]) else tools::toTitleCase(lvl)
      return(sprintf("%s (%s)", base_lab, lvl_lab))
    }
    stripped <- gsub("_sample$", "", nm)
    if (stripped %in% names(PHENOTYPE_LABELS))
      return(unname(PHENOTYPE_LABELS[stripped]))
    tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", nm))
  }, FUN.VALUE = character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

is_categorical_pheno <- function(x) {
  if (is.factor(x) || is.character(x) || is.logical(x)) return(TRUE)
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) <= 2)
  TRUE
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 0 — read metadata, restrict to infant samples
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# write.table() output: whitespace separated, quoted, with a leading row-name
# column that read.table() consumes automatically. quote = "\"" is required
# because several placental levels contain spaces.
metadata_all <- read.table(META_FILE, header = TRUE, quote = "\"",
                           na.strings = c("NA", ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                           comment.char = "")

phenos <- metadata_all[metadata_all$SampleType == "infant", , drop = FALSE]
rownames(phenos) <- phenos[[SAMPLE_ID]]

cat(sprintf("Read %d rows; %d infant samples from %d infants\n",
            nrow(metadata_all), nrow(phenos),
            dplyr::n_distinct(phenos[[INFANT_ID]])))

if (ONE_SAMPLE_PER_INFANT_PER_WEEK) {
  before <- nrow(phenos)
  phenos <- phenos %>%
    arrange(.data[[INFANT_ID]], week, Postnatal_Age) %>%
    group_by(.data[[INFANT_ID]], week) %>% dplyr::slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(phenos) <- phenos[[SAMPLE_ID]]
  cat(sprintf("Deduplicated to one sample per infant per week: %d -> %d samples\n",
              before, nrow(phenos)))
}

# ── Pin reference levels for the subtype factors ──────────────────────────────
subtype_levels <- list(
  fvm_type = c("none", "low grade", "high grade"),
  ch_type  = c("none", "segmental", "diffuse"),
  ca_type  = c("none", "maternal response only", "maternal and fetal response"),
  vue_type = c("none", "low grade", "high grade")
)
for (v in names(subtype_levels)) {
  if (!v %in% colnames(phenos)) { cat("!! missing column:", v, "\n"); next }
  unmatched <- setdiff(unique(na.omit(as.character(phenos[[v]]))), subtype_levels[[v]])
  if (length(unmatched) > 0)
    warning(sprintf("%s: values not in the declared levels become NA -> %s",
                    v, paste(unmatched, collapse = "; ")), call. = FALSE)
  phenos[[v]] <- factor(phenos[[v]], levels = subtype_levels[[v]])
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1 — species filtering and Aitchison distance
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Prevalence is counted per infant, not per sample: the infant identifier is
# the sample-ID prefix (B001_18_4E08 -> B001), which is 1:1 with MM_ID.
# vegdist(method = "aitchison") applies the CLR internally, so taxa_sp holds
# relative abundances rather than CLR-transformed values.
if (BUILD_DISTANCE) {

  stopifnot(exists("taxa_sp"))

  personal_ID <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(taxa_sp))

  # Numeric columns only: > on a character column is a string comparison.
  num_cols <- vapply(taxa_sp, is.numeric, logical(1))
  unique_counts <- vapply(taxa_sp[, num_cols, drop = FALSE],
                          function(x) length(unique(personal_ID[!is.na(x) & x > PREV_ABUNDANCE])),
                          integer(1))

  taxa_sp_filt <- taxa_sp[, names(unique_counts)[unique_counts >= MIN_PREV_INFANTS],
                          drop = FALSE]

  cat(sprintf("\nSpecies filter: %d of %d taxa present above %.3f in >= %d infant(s)\n",
              ncol(taxa_sp_filt), sum(num_cols), PREV_ABUNDANCE, MIN_PREV_INFANTS))

  # Align the taxa table to the phenotype table by row name.
  common <- intersect(rownames(phenos), rownames(taxa_sp_filt))
  cat(sprintf("Samples in both taxa table and metadata: %d (metadata %d, taxa %d)\n",
              length(common), nrow(phenos), nrow(taxa_sp_filt)))
  taxa_sp_filt <- taxa_sp_filt[common, , drop = FALSE]
  phenos       <- phenos[common, , drop = FALSE]

  my_pseudocount_normal <- min(taxa_sp_filt[taxa_sp_filt != 0]) / 2
  cat(sprintf("Pseudocount (half the smallest non-zero abundance): %.3g\n",
              my_pseudocount_normal))

  my_distance_CLR <- vegdist(taxa_sp_filt, method = "aitchison",
                             pseudocount = my_pseudocount_normal)
}

# ── Align distance matrix and phenotype table ─────────────────────────────────
shared_ids <- intersect(rownames(phenos), rownames(as.matrix(my_distance_CLR)))
cat(sprintf("Aligned: %d samples in phenotype table and distance matrix\n\n",
            length(shared_ids)))
phenos          <- phenos[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
my_distance_CLR <- as.dist(as.matrix(my_distance_CLR)[shared_ids, shared_ids])

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DIAGNOSTIC — infants per week x phenotype x level
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
build_level_counts <- function(phenotypes, phenos_to_test,
                               week_col = "week", id_col = INFANT_ID) {
  map_dfr(sort(unique(phenotypes[[week_col]])), function(tp) {
    sub <- phenotypes[phenotypes[[week_col]] == tp & !is.na(phenotypes[[week_col]]),
                      , drop = FALSE]
    map_dfr(intersect(phenos_to_test, colnames(sub)), function(pheno) {
      raw <- sub[[pheno]]; ok <- !is.na(raw); ids <- sub[[id_col]][ok]
      if (!is_categorical_pheno(raw)) {
        n_inf <- dplyr::n_distinct(ids)
        return(tibble(Timepoint = as.character(tp), Phenotype = pheno,
                      Type = "continuous", Level = NA_character_,
                      n_samples = sum(ok), n_infants = n_inf,
                      Share = NA_real_,
                      Below_min = n_inf < MIN_TOTAL_INFANTS))
      }
      v  <- raw[ok]
      lv <- if (is.factor(v)) levels(v) else sort(unique(as.character(v)))
      tot <- dplyr::n_distinct(ids)
      map_dfr(lv, function(l) {
        sel   <- !is.na(as.character(v)) & as.character(v) == l
        n_inf <- dplyr::n_distinct(ids[sel])
        tibble(Timepoint = as.character(tp), Phenotype = pheno,
               Type = "categorical", Level = as.character(l),
               n_samples = sum(sel), n_infants = n_inf,
               Share = if (tot > 0) round(n_inf / tot, 3) else NA_real_,
               Below_min = n_inf < MIN_LEVEL_INFANTS)
      })
    })
  }) %>% arrange(Phenotype, Timepoint, desc(n_infants))
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PERMANOVA — marginal (type III) SS, with both screening rules
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
run_adonis <- function(phenotypes, phenos_to_test, distance_mat,
                       perm = 10000, cores = 8,
                       id_col             = INFANT_ID,
                       min_level_n        = MIN_LEVEL_INFANTS,
                       min_total_n        = MIN_TOTAL_INFANTS,
                       max_majority       = MAX_MAJORITY_SHARE,
                       empty_level_action = EMPTY_LEVEL_ACTION,
                       timepoint_label    = NA_character_) {

  dist_mat <- as.matrix(distance_mat)
  skipped  <- list()
  note <- function(pheno, rule, reason, detail = NA_character_) {
    skipped[[length(skipped) + 1]] <<- tibble(
      Timepoint = as.character(timepoint_label), Phenotype = pheno,
      Rule = rule, Reason = reason, Detail = detail)
    NULL
  }

  res <- map_dfr(phenos_to_test, function(pheno) {

    if (!pheno %in% colnames(phenotypes)) return(note(pheno, "-", "not in table"))

    covariates <- intersect(c("Clean_reads_P1", "DNA_conc"), colnames(phenotypes))

    # Complete cases on the phenotype AND the covariates in the formula:
    # adonis2 runs with na.action = na.fail, so an NA covariate would error.
    keep <- !is.na(phenotypes[[pheno]])
    for (cv in covariates) keep <- keep & !is.na(phenotypes[[cv]])

    phenos_sub <- phenotypes[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    ids        <- phenos_sub[[id_col]]
    values     <- phenos_sub[[pheno]]
    n_inf_tot  <- dplyr::n_distinct(ids)

    if (n_inf_tot < min_total_n)
      return(note(pheno, "group size", "too few infants",
                  sprintf("%d infants (< %d)", n_inf_tot, min_total_n)))

    if (is_categorical_pheno(phenotypes[[pheno]])) {

      if (is.factor(values)) {
        empty_levels <- setdiff(levels(values), unique(as.character(values)))
        if (length(empty_levels) > 0) {
          if (identical(empty_level_action, "drop_factor"))
            return(note(pheno, "group size", "level absent in this week",
                        paste(empty_levels, collapse = "; ")))
          values <- droplevels(values)   # also prevents a rank-deficient design
        }
      } else {
        values <- factor(values)
      }

      inf_per_level <- vapply(levels(values), function(l)
        dplyr::n_distinct(ids[as.character(values) == l]), integer(1))
      detail <- paste(sprintf("%s=%d infants", names(inf_per_level), inf_per_level),
                      collapse = ", ")

      if (length(inf_per_level) < 2)
        return(note(pheno, "group size", "only one level present", detail))

      # ---- RULE 1: >= min_level_n distinct infants in EVERY level ------------
      if (any(inf_per_level < min_level_n))
        return(note(pheno, "group size",
                    sprintf("level with < %d infants", min_level_n), detail))

      # ---- RULE 2: the largest level holds <= max_majority of infants --------
      majority_share <- max(inf_per_level) / n_inf_tot
      if (majority_share > max_majority)
        return(note(pheno, "variance",
                    sprintf("largest level %.1f%% of infants (> %.0f%%)",
                            100 * majority_share, 100 * max_majority), detail))

      phenos_sub[[pheno]] <- values
      levels_tested <- paste(sprintf("%s=%d", names(inf_per_level), inf_per_level),
                             collapse = "; ")
      min_inf   <- as.integer(min(inf_per_level))
      maj_share <- round(majority_share, 3)

    } else {
      if (length(unique(values)) < 2) return(note(pheno, "variance", "no variation"))
      levels_tested <- "continuous"
      min_inf       <- NA_integer_
      maj_share     <- NA_real_
    }

    ids_sub  <- rownames(phenos_sub)
    dist_sub <- dist_mat[ids_sub, ids_sub]

    formula_str <- paste(
      "dist_sub ~",
      if (length(covariates) > 0) paste(c(covariates, pheno), collapse = " + ") else pheno
    )

    # by = "margin": each term is tested against the model containing all the
    # others, i.e. marginal (type III) sums of squares.
    ad <- tryCatch(
      adonis2(formula(formula_str), data = phenos_sub,
              permutations = perm, parallel = cores,
              by = "margin", na.action = na.fail),
      error = function(e) { note(pheno, "model", "adonis2 error", e$message); NULL }
    )
    if (is.null(ad)) return(NULL)

    # Locate the term by row name, not by position.
    pheno_row <- which(rownames(ad) == pheno)
    resid_row <- which(rownames(ad) == "Residual")
    if (length(pheno_row) == 0)
      return(note(pheno, "model", "term not found in adonis2 output",
                  paste(rownames(ad), collapse = "; ")))

    tibble(
      Phenotype      = pheno,
      Df             = ad$Df[pheno_row],
      F_stat         = ad[["F"]][pheno_row],
      R2             = ad$R2[pheno_row],
      p.value        = ad$`Pr(>F)`[pheno_row],
      Residual_Df    = if (length(resid_row)) ad$Df[resid_row] else NA_integer_,
      N_samples      = nrow(phenos_sub),
      N_infants      = n_inf_tot,
      Min_level_inf  = min_inf,
      Majority_share = maj_share,
      Levels_tested  = levels_tested
    )
  })

  list(results = res,
       skipped = if (length(skipped)) bind_rows(skipped) else tibble())
}

# ── STEP 2: group sizes per week, before anything is tested ───────────────────
level_counts <- build_level_counts(phenos, PHENOS_TO_TEST)
write.table(level_counts, "2A_level_counts_per_week.txt",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("--- Categorical levels with < %d infants (will NOT be tested) ---\n",
            MIN_LEVEL_INFANTS))
level_counts %>%
  filter(Type == "categorical", Below_min) %>%
  arrange(Phenotype, Timepoint) %>%
  print_all()
cat("\n")

# ── STEP 3: run PERMANOVA per timepoint ───────────────────────────────────────
# Permutation p-values are random; the seed makes them reproducible. adonis2
# draws the permutation matrix before parallelising, so this holds with
# parallel = 8.
set.seed(42)
adonis_runs <- map(
  sort(unique(phenos$week[!is.na(phenos$week)])),
  function(tp) {
    cat(sprintf("Analysing timepoint: %s\n", tp))
    phenotypes <- phenos %>% filter(week == tp)
    if (nrow(phenotypes) < MIN_SAMPLES_WEEK) {
      cat(sprintf("  Skipping — only %d samples\n", nrow(phenotypes)))
      return(NULL)
    }
    available <- PHENOS_TO_TEST[PHENOS_TO_TEST %in% colnames(phenotypes)]

    out <- run_adonis(phenotypes = phenotypes, phenos_to_test = available,
                      distance_mat = my_distance_CLR, perm = 10000, cores = 8,
                      timepoint_label = tp)

    if (nrow(out$results) > 0)
      out$results <- mutate(out$results, Timepoint = as.character(tp))
    cat(sprintf("  %d samples / %d infants — tested: %d   skipped: %d\n",
                nrow(phenotypes), dplyr::n_distinct(phenotypes[[INFANT_ID]]),
                nrow(out$results), nrow(out$skipped)))
    out
  }
)

ResultsAdonis <- map_dfr(compact(adonis_runs), "results")
SkippedAdonis <- map_dfr(compact(adonis_runs), "skipped")

write.table(ResultsAdonis, "2F_ResultsAdonis_subtypes.txt",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
write.table(SkippedAdonis, "2A_ResultsAdonis_skipped.txt",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# ── Sanity check ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat(sprintf("\nTotal results:           %d rows\n", nrow(ResultsAdonis)))
cat(sprintf("Rows with valid p.value: %d\n",       sum(!is.na(ResultsAdonis$p.value))))
cat(sprintf("Rows passing p < 0.001:  %d\n",
            sum(!is.na(ResultsAdonis$p.value) & ResultsAdonis$p.value < 0.001)))
cat(sprintf("Phenotype x week combinations skipped: %d\n", nrow(SkippedAdonis)))

if (nrow(SkippedAdonis) > 0) {
  cat("\n--- Exclusions by rule ---\n")
  SkippedAdonis %>% dplyr::count(Rule, Reason) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% print_all()

  cat(sprintf("\n--- Excluded by RULE 1 (< %d infants in a level) ---\n", MIN_LEVEL_INFANTS))
  SkippedAdonis %>% filter(Rule == "group size", grepl("^level with <", Reason)) %>%
    arrange(Phenotype, Timepoint) %>% print_all()

  cat(sprintf("\n--- Excluded by RULE 2 (largest level > %.0f%% of infants) ---\n",
              100 * MAX_MAJORITY_SHARE))
  SkippedAdonis %>% filter(Rule == "variance") %>%
    arrange(Phenotype, Timepoint) %>% print_all()
}

stopifnot(all(is.na(ResultsAdonis$Min_level_inf) |
              ResultsAdonis$Min_level_inf >= MIN_LEVEL_INFANTS))
stopifnot(all(is.na(ResultsAdonis$Majority_share) |
              ResultsAdonis$Majority_share <= MAX_MAJORITY_SHARE))
cat(sprintf("\n✓ Every reported categorical term has >= %d infants per level and a largest level <= %.0f%%\n\n",
            MIN_LEVEL_INFANTS, 100 * MAX_MAJORITY_SHARE))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FIGURE 1B — DOT PLOT
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ResultsAdonis <- read.delim("2F_ResultsAdonis_subtypes.txt") %>%
  mutate(across(c(Df, F_stat, R2, p.value), as.numeric)) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

significant2 <- ResultsAdonis %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.001, Df < 3, Timepoint != "Overall") %>%
  mutate(
    R2                 = round(R2, 3),
    Phenotype_readable = clean_phenotype_name(Phenotype)
  )

if (nrow(significant2) == 0) {
  stop("No significant results after filtering (p < 0.001, Df < 3). ",
       "Check the sanity check output above.")
}

unlabelled <- setdiff(unique(significant2$Phenotype), names(PHENOTYPE_LABELS))
unlabelled <- unlabelled[!grepl("__", unlabelled, fixed = TRUE)]
if (length(unlabelled) > 0)
  warning("No label defined for: ", paste(unlabelled, collapse = ", "),
          " — add them to PHENOTYPE_LABELS.", call. = FALSE)

cat("\n--- Row labels on the figure ---\n")
significant2 %>% dplyr::distinct(Phenotype, Phenotype_readable) %>%
  arrange(Phenotype) %>% print_all()

timepoint_order  <- as.character(1:8)
timepoint_labels <- setNames(paste("W", 1:8), timepoint_order)
phenotype_levels <- sort(unique(significant2$Phenotype_readable))

significant2 <- significant2 %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint          = factor(as.character(Timepoint),
                                levels = timepoint_order, ordered = TRUE),
    Phenotype_readable = factor(Phenotype_readable, levels = phenotype_levels)
  )

segments <- significant2 %>%
  group_by(Phenotype_readable) %>%
  summarise(
    first_tp = factor(min(as.integer(Timepoint)), levels = timepoint_order, ordered = TRUE),
    last_tp  = factor(max(as.integer(Timepoint)), levels = timepoint_order, ordered = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Phenotype_readable = factor(Phenotype_readable, levels = phenotype_levels))

adonis_plot <- ggplot(significant2, aes(y = Phenotype_readable)) +
  geom_segment(data = segments,
               aes(x = first_tp, xend = last_tp, yend = Phenotype_readable),
               colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3, inherit.aes = TRUE) +
  geom_point(aes(x = Timepoint, size = R2, fill = Timepoint),
             shape = 21, colour = "black") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(phenotype_levels)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = timepoint_order, labels = timepoint_labels) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "R²", range = c(1, 8),
                        limits = c(0, 0.2), breaks = seq(0, 0.2, 0.05)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", labels = timepoint_labels, name = "Timepoint") +
  xlab("Timepoint") + ylab("") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title         = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14))

print(adonis_plot)
ggsave("1B_permanova_results_subtypes.pdf", adonis_plot, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
cat("✓ Saved: 1B_permanova_results_subtypes.pdf\n")

# ── LEGEND NUMBERS: Fig. 1b ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Dots are selected on nominal p < 0.001 and Df < 3; the FDR column is BH
# within each week.
legend_out("Fig 1b — samples / infants analysed per week",
           phenos %>% filter(!is.na(week)) %>% n_si(week))
legend_out("Fig 1b — tests per week (BH family size, within week)",
           ResultsAdonis %>% dplyr::count(Timepoint, name = "n_tests"))
legend_out("Fig 1b — plotted dots (p < 0.001, Df < 3)",
           significant2 %>%
             transmute(Timepoint, Phenotype = Phenotype_readable, Df, R2,
                       p.value = signif(p.value, 3), FDR = signif(FDR, 3),
                       N_samples, N_infants, Levels_tested) %>%
             arrange(Phenotype, Timepoint))
legend_out("Fig 1b — selection rule check",
           sprintf("plotted dots: %d | with FDR < 0.05: %d | min/max p: %.2g / %.2g | max FDR: %.2g",
                   nrow(significant2), sum(significant2$FDR < 0.05),
                   min(significant2$p.value), max(significant2$p.value),
                   max(significant2$FDR)))
legend_out("Fig 1b — dots that WOULD be plotted under FDR < 0.05 (Df < 3) but are not",
           ResultsAdonis %>% filter(FDR < 0.05, Df < 3, p.value >= 0.001) %>%
             transmute(Timepoint, Phenotype, p.value = signif(p.value, 3),
                       FDR = signif(FDR, 3), N_samples, N_infants))
legend_out("Fig 1b — PERMANOVA settings",
           sprintf("adonis2, marginal SS (by = 'margin'), covariates: %s, permutations: 10000; screens: >= %d infants per level, largest level <= %.0f%%, >= %d infants for continuous, >= %d samples per week",
                   paste(intersect(c("Clean_reads_P1", "DNA_conc"), colnames(phenos)), collapse = " + "),
                   MIN_LEVEL_INFANTS, 100 * MAX_MAJORITY_SHARE, MIN_TOTAL_INFANTS, MIN_SAMPLES_WEEK))
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SUPPLEMENT — joint PERMANOVA of correlated predictors, per week
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Settings ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
JOINT_PREDICTORS <- c("probiotics", "ga_exact", "bw", "antibiotic_sample",
                      "delivery_md")
# Column that marks the sub-cohort (e.g. "subcohort", "study", "site").
# Leave NULL if there is none; set it to add sub-cohort as a predictor.
SUBCOHORT_VAR    <- NULL
TECH_COVARIATES  <- c("Clean_reads_P1", "DNA_conc")
JOINT_PERM       <- 10000
# Also run with one sample per infant per week (earliest), as a sensitivity
# analysis for infants sampled twice in the same week.
RUN_DEDUP        <- TRUE

stopifnot(exists("phenos"), exists("my_distance_CLR"))
predictors_all <- c(JOINT_PREDICTORS, SUBCOHORT_VAR)
missing_cols   <- setdiff(c(predictors_all, TECH_COVARIATES), colnames(phenos))
if (length(missing_cols)) stop("Not in phenos: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))

dist_all <- as.matrix(my_distance_CLR)

# Binary / character predictors as factors, continuous left numeric
prep_predictors <- function(df) {
  for (v in predictors_all)
    if (is_categorical_pheno(df[[v]])) df[[v]] <- factor(df[[v]])
  df
}

# ── One joint model per week ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
run_joint_week <- function(df, tp) {
  df   <- prep_predictors(df)
  keep <- stats::complete.cases(df[, c(TECH_COVARIATES, predictors_all), drop = FALSE])
  df   <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(df) < MIN_SAMPLES_WEEK) return(NULL)

  # Same screens as Fig. 1b, applied within this week's complete cases; a
  # predictor that fails is dropped from this week's model (and reported).
  used <- character(0); dropped <- character(0)
  for (v in predictors_all) {
    x <- df[[v]]; ids <- df[[INFANT_ID]]
    ok <- if (is.factor(x)) {
      x <- droplevels(x); df[[v]] <- x
      inf <- vapply(levels(x), function(l) dplyr::n_distinct(ids[x == l]), integer(1))
      length(inf) >= 2 && all(inf >= MIN_LEVEL_INFANTS) &&
        max(inf) / dplyr::n_distinct(ids) <= MAX_MAJORITY_SHARE
    } else {
      length(unique(x)) > 1 && dplyr::n_distinct(ids) >= MIN_TOTAL_INFANTS
    }
    if (ok) used <- c(used, v) else dropped <- c(dropped, v)
  }
  if (!length(used)) return(NULL)

  ids_s <- rownames(df)
  f <- stats::as.formula(paste("d ~", paste(c(TECH_COVARIATES, used), collapse = " + ")))
  d <- stats::as.dist(dist_all[ids_s, ids_s])
  set.seed(42)
  ad <- adonis2(f, data = df, permutations = JOINT_PERM, by = "margin",
                parallel = 8)
  tibble(Timepoint = as.character(tp), Term = rownames(ad),
         Df = ad$Df, R2 = ad$R2, F_stat = ad[["F"]], p.value = ad$`Pr(>F)`,
         N_samples = nrow(df), N_infants = dplyr::n_distinct(df[[INFANT_ID]]),
         Dropped_this_week = paste(dropped, collapse = "; ")) %>%
    filter(Term %in% used)
}

run_joint_all <- function(ph) {
  map_dfr(sort(unique(ph$week[!is.na(ph$week)])), function(tp)
    run_joint_week(ph[ph$week == tp & !is.na(ph$week), , drop = FALSE], tp))
}

joint_res <- run_joint_all(phenos) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>% mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, "BH")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Analysis = "joint, all samples")

if (RUN_DEDUP) {
  phenos_dedup <- phenos %>% tibble::rownames_to_column(".rid") %>%
    arrange(.data[[INFANT_ID]], week, Postnatal_Age) %>%
    group_by(.data[[INFANT_ID]], week) %>% dplyr::slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(phenos_dedup) <- phenos_dedup$.rid
  joint_dedup <- run_joint_all(phenos_dedup) %>%
    group_by(Timepoint) %>% mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, "BH")) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Analysis = "joint, one sample per infant per week")
  joint_res <- bind_rows(joint_res, joint_dedup)
}

# ── Side by side with the single-predictor results of Fig. 1b ─────────────────
single_res <- ResultsAdonis %>%
  filter(Phenotype %in% predictors_all) %>%
  transmute(Timepoint = as.character(Timepoint), Term = Phenotype,
            R2_single = R2, p_single = p.value)

joint_table <- joint_res %>%
  left_join(single_res, by = c("Timepoint", "Term")) %>%
  mutate(Term = clean_phenotype_name(Term),
         across(c(R2, R2_single), ~ round(.x, 4)),
         across(c(p.value, FDR, p_single), ~ signif(.x, 3)),
         F_stat = round(F_stat, 2)) %>%
  arrange(Analysis, as.numeric(Timepoint), Term)

write.table(joint_table, "1B_joint_PERMANOVA.txt", sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
legend_out("Supp — joint PERMANOVA per week (marginal SS; + reads + DNA conc)",
           joint_table)

# ── How correlated are the predictors? (one row per infant) ───────────────────
# Infant-level characteristics; antibiotic_sample varies by sample, so its
# infant mean is used here.
infant_tab <- prep_predictors(phenos) %>%
  group_by(.data[[INFANT_ID]]) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(predictors_all),
                   ~ if (is.factor(.x)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(dplyr::first(.x))))
                     else mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
# Keep predictors that are numeric or binary 0/1; a sub-cohort with named levels
# (more than two) cannot enter a rank correlation and is left out here.
num_ok   <- vapply(infant_tab[, predictors_all], function(x) sum(!is.na(x)) > 2, logical(1))
cor_mat  <- stats::cor(infant_tab[, predictors_all[num_ok]], method = "spearman",
                       use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
cor_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(V1 = Var1, V2 = Var2, rho = Freq) %>%
  filter(as.character(V1) < as.character(V2)) %>%
  mutate(rho = round(rho, 2)) %>% arrange(desc(abs(rho)))
write.table(cor_long, "1B_predictor_correlations.txt", sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
legend_out(sprintf("Supp — Spearman correlations between predictors (one row per infant, n = %d)",
                   nrow(infant_tab)), cor_long)

# Variance inflation within the joint model (pooled samples)
if (requireNamespace("car", quietly = TRUE)) {
  vif_df <- prep_predictors(phenos)
  vif_df <- vif_df[stats::complete.cases(vif_df[, c(TECH_COVARIATES, predictors_all)]), ]
  set.seed(1); vif_df$.y <- stats::rnorm(nrow(vif_df))
  v <- car::vif(stats::lm(stats::as.formula(paste(".y ~",
         paste(c(TECH_COVARIATES, predictors_all), collapse = " + "))), data = vif_df))
  v <- if (is.matrix(v)) v[, ncol(v)]^2 else v
  legend_out("Supp — VIF of the joint model terms (pooled samples; >5 = concerning)",
             data.frame(Term = names(v), VIF = round(as.numeric(v), 2)))
}

# Heatmap of the correlations, for the supplement
pheatmap::pheatmap(cor_mat, display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.2f",
                   breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 51),
                   color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b"))(50),
                   labels_row = clean_phenotype_name(rownames(cor_mat)),
                   labels_col = clean_phenotype_name(colnames(cor_mat)),
                   cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
                   filename = "1B_predictor_correlations.pdf", width = 5, height = 4.5)
cat("✓ Saved: 1B_joint_PERMANOVA.txt, 1B_predictor_correlations.txt/.pdf\n")
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(ape); library(ggtree)

# ── Metadata ──────────────────────────────────────────────
meta <- read.delim("metadata_cleaned_april.txt") %>%
  mutate(
    label      = as.character(ID),
    SampleType = trimws(as.character(SampleType)),
    SampleType = factor(SampleType,
                        levels = c("maternal", "infant", "probiotic",
                                   "negative", "positive")),
    probiotics = factor(as.character(probiotics), levels = c(0, 1))
  )

# ── Tree + tip cleaning (unchanged) ───────────────────────
tree <- read.tree("RAxML_bestTree.t__SGB17248.StrainPhlAn4.tre")
tree$tip.label <- sub("^(([^_]*_){3}).*$", "\\1", tree$tip.label)
tree$tip.label <- sub("_$", "", tree$tip.label)
tree$tip.label <- sub("MG10BOMPC1_ZKDN250026178-1A_2323WCLT3", "P300_00_13H1", tree$tip.label)
tree$tip.label <- sub("MG10BOMPC2_ZKDN250026179-1A_2323WCLT3", "P300_00_13H2", tree$tip.label)
n_tips_raw     <- length(tree$tip.label)
tips_no_meta   <- tree$tip.label[!tree$tip.label %in% meta$label]
tree <- drop.tip(tree, tree$tip.label[!tree$tip.label %in% meta$label])

# ── Tip data + four-level exposure variable ───────────────
tip_data <- tibble(label = tree$tip.label) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "label") %>%
  mutate(
    exposure = case_when(
      SampleType == "maternal"                            ~ "maternal",
      SampleType %in% c("probiotic", "negative", "positive") ~ "control",
      SampleType == "infant" & probiotics == "1"          ~ "infant_exposed",
      SampleType == "infant" & probiotics == "0"          ~ "infant_unexposed",
      TRUE                                                ~ "control"
    ),
    exposure = factor(exposure,
      levels = c("infant_exposed", "infant_unexposed", "maternal", "control"))
  )

print(table(tip_data$exposure, useNA = "always"))

# ── Aesthetics ────────────────────────────────────────────
exposure_colors <- c(
  infant_exposed   = "#199e70",   # teal   — matches figure 1C "Yes"
  infant_unexposed = "#4a3aa7",   # violet — matches figure 1C "No"
  maternal         = "#d95926",   # orange — replaces #009E73, which was
                                  #          indistinguishable from the teal
  control          = "#1a1a1a"    # near-black — reference category
)

# Circles for the two infant groups so they differ ONLY in colour; a distinct
# outline for the two non-infant categories.
exposure_shapes <- c(
  infant_exposed   = 21,   # circle
  infant_unexposed = 21,   # circle
  maternal         = 24,   # triangle
  control          = 22    # square
)

exposure_labels <- c(
  infant_exposed   = "Probiotic-exposed",
  infant_unexposed = "Non-exposed",
  maternal         = "Maternal",
  control          = "Probiotic Control"
)

# ── Plot: circular fan ────────────────────────────────────
p_pub <- ggtree(tree, layout = "fan", open.angle = 20,
                color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3) %<+% tip_data +
  geom_tippoint(
    aes(fill = exposure, shape = exposure),
    size = 5, colour = "grey15", stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  # Identical name and labels on both scales, so ggplot merges fill and shape
  # into a single legend rather than drawing two.
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = exposure_colors, name = NULL, labels = exposure_labels,
    na.value = "grey80",
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.6))
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = exposure_shapes, name = NULL, labels = exposure_labels,
    na.value = 21,
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.6))
  ) +
  ggtree::hexpand(-0.1) +
  theme_void(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.key       = element_blank(),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin      = margin(6, 6, 6, 6)
  )

p_pub

ggsave("1D_Longum_tree_publication.pdf", p_pub, width = 7, height = 4.5, device = pdf)

# ── LEGEND NUMBERS: Fig. 1d ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_out("Fig 1d — tips in StrainPhlAn tree (SGB17248)",
           sprintf("in tree file: %d | dropped (no metadata match): %d | plotted: %d",
                   n_tips_raw, length(tips_no_meta), length(tree$tip.label)))
if (length(tips_no_meta))
  legend_out("Fig 1d — dropped tip labels", tips_no_meta)
legend_out("Fig 1d — plotted tips by category (samples; distinct MM_ID = mother-infant pair / infant)",
           tip_data %>% n_si(exposure))
legend_out("Fig 1d — control tips by SampleType",
           tip_data %>% filter(exposure == "control") %>% dplyr::count(SampleType))
```

```{r}
#Figure 1E — Probiotic exposure vs key bile acid CLR coordinates

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(zCompositions)

DATA_DIR <- "."
p <- function(f) file.path(DATA_DIR, f)

set.seed(42)   # (2) geom_jitter is random — fix it

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Load & assemble data        (1) all objects suffixed _ba
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
PBC_248_resultaten <- read_excel(p("PBC_248_resultaten.xlsx"))
bili_ba            <- read_excel(p("bili.xlsx"))

id_ba <- PBC_248_resultaten %>%
  select(Nr, ID, postnatal_day) %>%
  mutate(Nr = gsub(" ", "-", Nr), MM_ID = ID, ID = Nr) %>%
  select(-Nr)

merged_ba <- id_ba %>% left_join(bili_ba, by = "ID") %>% select(-ID)

metadata_ba <- read.delim(p("metadata_cleaned_april.txt"))
row.names(metadata_ba) <- metadata_ba$ID
metadata_infant_ba <- metadata_ba[grep("^B", rownames(metadata_ba)), ]

bili_total_ba <- metadata_infant_ba %>%
  left_join(merged_ba, by = c("MM_ID" = "MM_ID",
                              "Postnatal_Age" = "postnatal_day"))

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Bile acid species & conjugation classes
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ba_cols <- c("GLCA-3S","TLCA-3S","LCA","UDCA","HDCA","CDCA","DCA","CA","HCA",
             "GLCA","GUDCA","GHDCA","GCDCA","GDCA","LCA-3S","GCA","TLCA",
             "TUDCA","THDCA","TCDCA","TDCA","TCA")

conjugated   <- c("GLCA-3S","TLCA-3S","GLCA","GUDCA","GHDCA","GCDCA","GDCA",
                  "GCA","LCA-3S","TLCA","TUDCA","THDCA","TCDCA","TDCA","TCA")
unconjugated <- c("LCA","UDCA","HDCA","CDCA","DCA","CA","HCA")

stopifnot(length(setdiff(ba_cols, colnames(bili_total_ba))) == 0)

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. Zero replacement and CLR transform        (8)
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
clr_rows <- function(mat) {
  L <- log(as.matrix(mat))
  sweep(L, 1, rowMeans(L), "-")          # each row minus its own geometric mean
}

ba_raw <- bili_total_ba %>%
  select(ID, all_of(ba_cols)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ID")
ba_raw[is.na(ba_raw)] <- 0
ba_raw <- ba_raw[rowSums(ba_raw) > 0, colSums(ba_raw) > 0, drop = FALSE]

cat("\n--- zero structure ---\n")
cat("samples: ", nrow(ba_raw), " | species: ", ncol(ba_raw),
    " | zeros: ", round(mean(as.matrix(ba_raw) == 0) * 100, 1), "%\n", sep = "")

## (8a) Primary: Bayesian-multiplicative replacement (count zero multiplicative).
## z.warning is raised because several bile acids are legitimately absent from
## most samples; z.delete = FALSE keeps those columns rather than dropping them.
ba_repl <- tryCatch(
  as.matrix(cmultRepl(ba_raw, label = 0, method = "CZM",
                      z.warning = 1, z.delete = FALSE, suppress.print = TRUE)),
  error = function(e) { message("cmultRepl failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })

## (8b) Simple multiplicative replacement, for comparison.
mult_repl <- function(mat) {
  t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) {
    pos <- x[x > 0]
    if (length(pos) == 0) return(x)
    x[x == 0] <- min(pos) / 2
    x / sum(x)
  }))
}
ba_repl_simple <- mult_repl(ba_raw)
rownames(ba_repl_simple) <- rownames(ba_raw)

if (is.null(ba_repl)) {
  message("Falling back to the simple min(positive)/2 replacement.")
  ba_repl <- ba_repl_simple
} else {
  rownames(ba_repl) <- rownames(ba_raw)
  ## How much does the choice of imputation matter? Report it rather than assume.
  agree <- diag(cor(clr_rows(ba_repl), clr_rows(ba_repl_simple),
                    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  cat("\n--- CLR agreement between cmultRepl (CZM) and min/2 replacement ---\n")
  cat("  per-coordinate Pearson r: min ", round(min(agree), 3),
      " | median ", round(median(agree), 3),
      " | max ", round(max(agree), 3), "\n", sep = "")
}

ba_clr <- clr_rows(ba_repl)
rownames(ba_clr) <- rownames(ba_raw)

conj_set   <- intersect(conjugated,   colnames(ba_repl))
unconj_set <- intersect(unconjugated, colnames(ba_repl))
conj_unconj_lr <- log(rowSums(ba_repl[, conj_set,   drop = FALSE]) /
                      rowSums(ba_repl[, unconj_set, drop = FALSE]))

bili_clr_mat <- as.data.frame(ba_clr)
bili_clr_mat$conj_unconj_lr <- conj_unconj_lr[rownames(bili_clr_mat)]

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 4. Distribution check on the CLR coordinates
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
skewness <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]; n <- length(x); if (n < 3) return(NA_real_)
  m <- mean(x); sqrt(n) * sum((x - m)^3) / (sum((x - m)^2)^1.5)
}
safe_shapiro <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(unique(x)) < 3 || length(x) < 3 || length(x) > 5000) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(shapiro.test(x)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

clr_long <- bili_clr_mat %>%
  rownames_to_column("ID") %>%
  pivot_longer(-ID, names_to = "bile_acid", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value))

clr_dist <- clr_long %>%
  group_by(bile_acid) %>%
  summarise(skew = skewness(value),
            shapiro_p = safe_shapiro(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(skew)))
print(as.data.frame(clr_dist))

ggplot(clr_long, aes(sample = value)) +
  stat_qq(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.5, colour = "#2c7fb8") +
  stat_qq_line(colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ bile_acid, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Theoretical quantiles", y = "Sample quantiles",
       title = "CLR-transformed bile acids - normal QQ") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9))

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 5. Mixed-model machinery (random intercept per infant: MM_ID)
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fit_lmer_flagged <- function(formula, data) {
  rank_def <- FALSE; singular <- FALSE
  fit <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      lmer(formula, data, REML = FALSE),
      warning = function(w) {
        msg <- conditionMessage(w)
        if (grepl("rank deficient", msg, ignore.case = TRUE)) rank_def <<- TRUE
        if (grepl("singular",       msg, ignore.case = TRUE)) singular <<- TRUE
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  list(fit = fit, rank_def = rank_def, singular = singular)
}

mixed_models_bili <- function(metadata, ID, bili_data, pheno_list,
                              covariates = "Postnatal_Age") {
  df <- metadata
  row.names(df) <- df[[ID]]
  df <- merge(df, bili_data, by = "row.names")
  row.names(df) <- df$Row.names
  df$Row.names <- NULL

  Bile_acids <- colnames(bili_data)
  cov_string <- paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  Overall_result <- tibble()

  for (BA in Bile_acids) {
    if (!BA %in% colnames(df)) next
    BA2 <- paste0("`", BA, "`")

    for (pheno in pheno_list) {
      if (!pheno %in% colnames(df)) next
      pheno2 <- paste0("`", pheno, "`")

      To_keep  <- df[[ID]][!is.na(df[[pheno]]) & !is.na(df[[BA]])]
      df_pheno <- df[df[[ID]] %in% To_keep, ]
      if (nrow(df_pheno) < 10) next

      Model0 <- as.formula(paste0(BA2, " ~ ", cov_string, " + (1|MM_ID)"))
      Model2 <- as.formula(paste0(BA2, " ~ ", cov_string, " + ",
                                  pheno2, " + (1|MM_ID)"))

      base <- fit_lmer_flagged(Model0, df_pheno)
      full <- fit_lmer_flagged(Model2, df_pheno)
      if (is.null(base$fit) || is.null(full$fit)) next

      ## Positional LRT row — robust to how anova() names the models.
      aov_tab <- as.data.frame(anova(full$fit, base$fit))
      p_lrt   <- aov_tab[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][nrow(aov_tab)]

      coefs <- as.data.frame(summary(full$fit)$coefficients)
      ## (3) anchored: grep(pheno, ...) also matched longer coefficient names,
      ## e.g. pheno "TFEF" matching a "TFEF_B..." row.
      Summ  <- coefs[grep(paste0("^", pheno), rownames(coefs)), , drop = FALSE]
      if (nrow(Summ) == 0) next

      temp <- Summ %>%
        rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%
        as_tibble() %>%
        mutate(P = p_lrt, N_samples = nrow(df_pheno),
               N_infants = n_distinct(df_pheno$MM_ID),
               Singular_fit = full$singular, Rank_def = full$rank_def,
               BileAcid = BA, Pheno = pheno)

      Overall_result <- rbind(Overall_result, temp)
    }
  }

  p <- as.data.frame(Overall_result)
  if (nrow(p) > 0) {
    p$FDR <- NA_real_
    keep <- !p$Rank_def
    p$FDR[keep] <- p.adjust(p$P[keep], method = "BH")
    ## (4) The FDR family: BH runs across every phenotype x coordinate pair in
    ## ONE call, not per panel. Report it; it belongs in the figure legend.
    attr(p, "fdr_family_size") <- sum(keep)
  }
  p
}

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 6. Run the CLR analysis
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
metadata_only_ba <- bili_total_ba %>% select(-all_of(ba_cols))

phenos <- c("prolonged_rupt","mmpercentage","surgery","ab48","apgar_1",
            "apgar_5","multiple","delivery_md","maternal_atb","mother_st_com",
            "placenta_ab","pe_hellp","maternal_infect","mother_b_hem",
            "antibiotic_sample","probiotic_sample","ga_exact","bw","nec",
            "sex","admissiontime","tpn_days","sip","sepsis_culture",
            "pda_sign","mortality","week","probiotics","SGA","LGA","FGR",
            "TFEF_B","TFEF","ivh","abtx")

results_clr <- mixed_models_bili(
  metadata   = metadata_only_ba,
  ID         = "ID",
  bili_data  = bili_clr_mat,
  pheno_list = phenos
)

## (4) Report the multiple-testing family explicitly.
cat("\n--- multiple testing ---\n")
cat("  phenotypes tested:      ", n_distinct(results_clr$Pheno), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  coordinates tested:     ", n_distinct(results_clr$BileAcid), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  tests in the BH family: ", attr(results_clr, "fdr_family_size"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  -> FDR is adjusted across ALL phenotype x coordinate pairs jointly,\n",
    "     not within panels. State this in the Figure 1E legend.\n", sep = "")

results_clr_sig <- results_clr %>%
  filter(!Rank_def, !Singular_fit, FDR < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(FDR)

write.csv(results_clr, p("1E_bileacid_full_screen.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 6b. What else associates with bile acids? (exploratory)
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## The screen in section 6 already tests every phenotype against every
## coordinate; this block only summarises it.

clean <- results_clr %>% filter(!Rank_def, !Singular_fit, !is.na(P))

## Which phenotypes have any signal, and how strong?
pheno_summary <- clean %>%
  group_by(Pheno) %>%
  summarise(n_tested     = dplyr::n(),
            n_FDR05      = sum(FDR < 0.05,  na.rm = TRUE),
            n_FDR01      = sum(FDR < 0.01,  na.rm = TRUE),
            n_FDR001     = sum(FDR < 0.001, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_FDR      = min(FDR, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_abs_beta = max(abs(Estimate), na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_FDR05 > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_FDR05), min_FDR)

cat("\n--- phenotypes associated with any bile acid coordinate ---\n")
print(as.data.frame(pheno_summary %>%
        mutate(across(c(min_FDR, max_abs_beta), ~ signif(.x, 3)))),
      row.names = FALSE)

## Is probiotic exposure really the dominant factor? Two criteria.
cat("\n--- rank of `probiotics` ---\n")
cat("  by number of coordinates at FDR<0.05: ",
    which(pheno_summary$Pheno == "probiotics"), " of ",
    nrow(pheno_summary), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  by smallest FDR:                      ",
    which(order(pheno_summary$min_FDR) ==
          which(pheno_summary$Pheno == "probiotics")), "\n", sep = "")

## Every non-probiotic hit, for the supplement.
cat("\n--- all associations at FDR<0.05, excluding probiotic variables ---\n")
print(as.data.frame(
  clean %>%
    filter(FDR < 0.05, !Pheno %in% c("probiotics", "probiotic_sample")) %>%
    arrange(FDR) %>%
    transmute(Pheno, BileAcid,
              Beta = signif(Estimate, 3), SE = signif(`Std. Error`, 3),
              FDR = signif(FDR, 3), N_samples, N_infants)),
  row.names = FALSE)

## Sensitivity: how much of that survives a stricter threshold?
cat("\n--- surviving FDR<0.01 and FDR<0.001 (non-probiotic) ---\n")
print(clean %>%
  filter(!Pheno %in% c("probiotics", "probiotic_sample")) %>%
  summarise(FDR05 = sum(FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            FDR01 = sum(FDR < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
            FDR001 = sum(FDR < 0.001, na.rm = TRUE)))

write.csv(pheno_summary, p("1E_phenotype_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 7. Figure
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
focus <- c("conj_unconj_lr", "CA", "TCA", "CDCA", "TCDCA")
## (6) The first coordinate is a summary LOG-RATIO, not a CLR coordinate; the
## facet label and the axis title now say so.
focus_labels <- c("Con/Uncon", "CA", "TCA", "CDCA", "TCDCA")

## Shared with figures 1C and 1F — define once, never retype the hex.
PROBIOTIC_COLS <- c(No = "#4a3aa7", Yes = "#199e70")   # points, outlines
PROBIOTIC_TINT <- c(No = "#dedcef", Yes = "#d6eee5")   # 18% tint: box fill

plot_df <- bili_clr_mat %>%
  rownames_to_column("ID") %>%
  select(ID, any_of(focus)) %>%
  left_join(bili_total_ba %>% select(ID, MM_ID, probiotics), by = "ID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(probiotics)) %>%
  pivot_longer(any_of(focus), names_to = "coord", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(probiotics = factor(probiotics, levels = c(0, 1),
                             labels = c("No", "Yes")),
         coord      = factor(coord, levels = focus, labels = focus_labels))

fmt_p <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA",
                     ifelse(x < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("%.3f", x)))

pval_df <- results_clr %>%
  filter(Pheno == "probiotics", BileAcid %in% focus) %>%
  group_by(BileAcid) %>%
  slice_min(P, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(coord = factor(BileAcid, levels = focus, labels = focus_labels),
            label = paste0("FDR = ", fmt_p(FDR)))

## Group sizes behind each panel, in samples and in infants — the number a
## reviewer will ask for. Note that probiotic exposure is time-varying, so an
## infant can contribute samples to both groups.
cat("\n--- group sizes per panel ---\n")
print(as.data.frame(
  plot_df %>% group_by(coord, probiotics) %>%
    summarise(n_samples = dplyr::n(),
```

```{r}
## Figure 1F — Bile salt hydrolase (BSH) gene detection and abundance

library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(blme)
library(patchwork)

## Set to the directory holding the input files. Paths are built from this so
## the script does not depend on the working directory.
DATA_DIR <- "."
p <- function(f) file.path(DATA_DIR, f)

set.seed(42)   # geom_jitter is random; fix it so the figure is reproducible

## ---- Parameters -------------------------------------------------------------
MIN_PREVALENCE  <- 10   # % of infant samples a marker must reach to be screened
MIN_GROUP_N     <- 5    # minimum detected samples per group for the abundance fit

FOCUS <- c(
  "SBA_PROT_ALL_000062",   # WP_007052221.1, BSH, Bifidobacterium longum
  "SBA_PROT_ALL_000048"    # WP_004217908.1, BSH, B. animalis subsp. lactis
)
FOCUS_LABELS <- c(
  SBA_PROT_ALL_000062 = "BSH~(italic('B. longum'))",
  SBA_PROT_ALL_000048 = "BSH~(italic('B. animalis'))"
)

## Shared with Figures 1C and 1E — defined once.
PROBIOTIC_COLS <- c(No = "#4a3aa7", Yes = "#199e70")   # points, outlines
PROBIOTIC_TINT <- c(No = "#dedcef", Yes = "#d6eee5")   # box fill

## ---- STEP 1. ShortBRED matrix ----------------------------------------------
SBA <- read.delim(p("ShortBRED_Bile_acids_Count_matrix.tsv"), check.names = FALSE)

## Sample IDs: B002_20_4C09_EKDN... -> B002_20_4C09
SBA$ID <- sub("^([^_]+_[^_]+_[^_]+).*", "\\1", SBA$Sample)

## The two MG10 samples are the sequenced ProPrems product, not infant stool.
SBA$ID[SBA$ID == "MG10BOMPC1_ZKDN250026178-1A_2323WCLT3"] <- "P300_00_13H1"
SBA$ID[SBA$ID == "MG10BOMPC2_ZKDN250026179-1A_2323WCLT3"] <- "P300_00_13H2"

gene_cols <- setdiff(colnames(SBA), c("Sample", "ID"))

## Normalisation diagnostic. If these were raw counts, every non-zero value in a
## sample would be an integer multiple of a common per-sample constant and the
## per-sample minimum would be ~1. Neither holds, which is the signature of
## division by BOTH marker length and library size, i.e. RPKM.
.d <- as.matrix(SBA[, gene_cols])
cat("\n--- Normalisation diagnostic ---\n")
cat("  all non-zero values integer? ",
    isTRUE(all.equal(.d[.d > 0], round(.d[.d > 0]))), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  distinct per-sample minimum non-zero values: ",
    length(unique(apply(.d, 1, function(x) { x <- x[x > 0]
                                             if (length(x)) min(x) else NA }))),
    " of ", nrow(.d), " samples\n", sep = "")
rm(.d)

## ---- STEP 2. Metadata, infants only ----------------------------------------
metadata <- read.table(p("meta_with_placental_subtypes.txt"), header = TRUE,
                       quote = "\"", na.strings = c("NA", ""),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE, comment.char = "")
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$ID

meta_inf_all <- metadata[grep("^B", rownames(metadata)), ]
for (v in c("MM_ID", "Postnatal_Age", "Clean_reads_P1", "DNA_conc"))
  meta_inf_all[[v]] <- as.numeric(meta_inf_all[[v]])
meta_inf_all$probiotics <- factor(as.character(meta_inf_all$probiotics),
                                  levels = c("0", "1"), labels = c("No", "Yes"))

common   <- intersect(meta_inf_all$ID, SBA$ID)
meta_inf <- meta_inf_all[match(common, meta_inf_all$ID), ]
SBA_inf  <- SBA[match(common, SBA$ID), ]
stopifnot(identical(meta_inf$ID, SBA_inf$ID))

abund <- as.matrix(sapply(SBA_inf[, gene_cols, drop = FALSE], as.numeric))
rownames(abund) <- SBA_inf$ID

cat("\ninfant samples with ShortBRED data: ", nrow(abund),
    " | with no marker detected: ", sum(rowSums(abund > 0) == 0), "\n", sep = "")

## ---- STEP 3. Marker screen set ---------------------------------------------
prev           <- colMeans(abund > 0) * 100
screen_markers <- names(prev)[prev >= MIN_PREVALENCE]
cat("markers screened: ", length(screen_markers), " of ", length(gene_cols),
    " (prevalence >= ", MIN_PREVALENCE, "%)\n", sep = "")
stopifnot(all(FOCUS %in% sub("\\|.*", "", screen_markers)))

## Bai genes are essentially absent: the preterm gut here has almost no
## 7alpha-dehydroxylation capacity, so true secondary bile acids cannot form.
subfam <- sub(".*gene_subfamily=([^|]*).*", "\\1", gene_cols)
cat("\nmax infant prevalence by gene subfamily (%):\n")
print(round(tapply(prev, subfam, max), 1))

## ---- STEP 4. Modelling table ------------------------------------------------
## Clean_reads_P1 is ~1e6-1e7; on that scale glmer's optimiser fails outright,
## so covariates are z-scaled for the models. Plotted values are untouched.
COVARIATES <- c("Clean_reads_P1", "DNA_conc", "Postnatal_Age")
cov_string <- paste0(COVARIATES, "_z", collapse = " + ")

base_df <- meta_inf %>%
  select(ID, MM_ID, all_of(COVARIATES), probiotics) %>%
  filter(if_all(c(all_of(COVARIATES), probiotics), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(COVARIATES), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)), .names = "{.col}_z"))

cat("\ninfants per exposure group (sum exceeds the infant count because",
    "exposure is time-varying):\n")
print(tapply(base_df$MM_ID, base_df$probiotics, function(x) length(unique(x))))
cat("distinct infants: ", n_distinct(base_df$MM_ID), "\n", sep = "")

## ---- STEP 5. Model machinery ------------------------------------------------
fit_lmm <- function(formula, data) {
  singular <- FALSE
  fit <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      lmer(formula, data, REML = FALSE),
      warning = function(w) {
        if (grepl("singular", conditionMessage(w), ignore.case = TRUE))
          singular <<- TRUE
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  list(fit = fit, singular = singular)
}

## Penalised logistic mixed model: a weakly informative normal prior on the
## fixed effects regularises the diverging coefficient under separation while
## retaining the (1|MM_ID) random intercept.
fit_penalised <- function(formula, data) {
  tryCatch(
    bglmer(formula, data = data, family = binomial,
           fixef.prior = normal(sd = 3),
           control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                  optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))),
    error = function(e) { message("bglmer failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
}

lrt_p <- function(m1, m0) {
  a <- anova(m1, m0)
  a[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][nrow(a)]        # positional: works for lmer and glmer alike
}

run_detection <- function(df) {
  f0 <- as.formula(paste0("detected ~ ", cov_string, " + (1|MM_ID)"))
  f1 <- as.formula(paste0("detected ~ ", cov_string, " + probiotics + (1|MM_ID)"))
  m0 <- fit_penalised(f0, df); m1 <- fit_penalised(f1, df)
  if (is.null(m0) || is.null(m1))
    return(tibble(Note = "penalised fit failed", N_samples = nrow(df),
                  N_infants = n_distinct(df$MM_ID)))
  cf  <- as.data.frame(summary(m1)$coefficients)
  rw  <- cf[grep("^probiotics", rownames(cf)), , drop = FALSE]
  est <- rw[[1]][1]; se <- rw[[2]][1]
  tibble(Estimate = est, SE = se, P = lrt_p(m1, m0),
         OR = exp(est), OR_lo = exp(est - 1.96 * se), OR_hi = exp(est + 1.96 * se),
         N_samples = nrow(df), N_infants = n_distinct(df$MM_ID),
         Note = NA_character_)
}

run_abundance <- function(df) {
  f0 <- as.formula(paste0("log_value ~ ", cov_string, " + (1|MM_ID)"))
  f1 <- as.formula(paste0("log_value ~ ", cov_string, " + probiotics + (1|MM_ID)"))
  m0 <- fit_lmm(f0, df); m1 <- fit_lmm(f1, df)
  if (is.null(m0$fit) || is.null(m1$fit))
    return(tibble(Note = "model failed", N_samples = nrow(df),
                  N_infants = n_distinct(df$MM_ID)))
  cf <- as.data.frame(summary(m1$fit)$coefficients)
  rw <- cf[grep("^probiotics", rownames(cf)), , drop = FALSE]
  tibble(Estimate = rw[[1]][1], SE = rw[[2]][1], P = lrt_p(m1$fit, m0$fit),
         N_samples = nrow(df), N_infants = n_distinct(df$MM_ID),
         Singular = m1$singular, Note = NA_character_)
}

## ---- STEP 6. Separation diagnostic and the two-part screen -------------------
sep_table <- map_dfr(screen_markers, function(g) {
  d <- base_df %>% mutate(det = abund[match(ID, rownames(abund)), g] > 0)
  tibble(Marker = g,
         n_No  = sum(d$probiotics == "No"),
         k_No  = sum(d$det[d$probiotics == "No"]),
         n_Yes = sum(d$probiotics == "Yes"),
         k_Yes = sum(d$det[d$probiotics == "Yes"]),
         separation = if (any(table(d$probiotics, d$det) == 0)) "complete" else "none")
})
cat("\n--- separation diagnostic ---\n")
print(as.data.frame(sep_table %>% mutate(Marker = sub("\\|.*", "", Marker))),
      row.names = FALSE)

res_detect <- map_dfr(screen_markers, function(g) {
  df <- base_df %>%
    mutate(detected = as.integer(abund[match(ID, rownames(abund)), g] > 0))
  if (n_distinct(df$detected) < 2)
    return(tibble(Marker = g, Note = "no variation in detection"))
  run_detection(df) %>% mutate(Marker = g)
}) %>% mutate(Part = "Detection")

res_abund <- map_dfr(screen_markers, function(g) {
  df <- base_df %>%
    mutate(value = abund[match(ID, rownames(abund)), g]) %>%
    filter(value > 0) %>%
    mutate(log_value = log10(value))
  n_grp <- table(factor(df$probiotics, levels = c("No", "Yes")))
  if (any(n_grp < MIN_GROUP_N))
    return(tibble(Marker = g, N_samples = nrow(df),
                  N_infants = n_distinct(df$MM_ID),
                  Note = sprintf("not estimable: detected in n=%d (No), n=%d (Yes)",
                                 n_grp[["No"]], n_grp[["Yes"]])))
  run_abundance(df) %>% mutate(Marker = g)
}) %>% mutate(Part = "Abundance")

add_fdr <- function(d) {
  d$FDR <- NA_real_
  ok <- !is.na(d$P)
  if ("Singular" %in% names(d)) ok <- ok & (is.na(d$Singular) | !d$Singular)
  d$FDR[ok] <- p.adjust(d$P[ok], method = "BH")
  d
}

## Markers present in the sequenced ProPrems product are the administered
## strains' own genes, by direct observation rather than inference.
product <- SBA[SBA$ID %in% c("P300_00_13H1", "P300_00_13H2"), ]
product_markers <- if (nrow(product)) {
  pm <- as.matrix(product[, gene_cols, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(pm)[colSums(pm > 0) > 0]
} else character(0)

results_bsh <- bind_rows(add_fdr(res_detect), add_fdr(res_abund)) %>%
  left_join(sep_table, by = "Marker") %>%
  mutate(Subfamily  = sub(".*gene_subfamily=([^|]*).*", "\\1", Marker),
         Marker_id  = sub("\\|.*", "", Marker),
         In_product = Marker %in% product_markers,
         Plotted    = Marker_id %in% FOCUS) %>%
  arrange(Part, FDR)

cat("\n--- tests performed (the FDR family; state this in the legend) ---\n")
print(results_bsh %>% filter(!is.na(P)) %>% dplyr::count(Part))
cat("\n--- significant at FDR < 0.05 ---\n")
print(as.data.frame(results_bsh %>% filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
        select(Part, Subfamily, Marker_id, In_product, Plotted, separation,
               Estimate, SE, OR, OR_lo, OR_hi, P, FDR, N_samples, N_infants)),
      row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(results_bsh, p("1F_BSH_probiotics_full_screen.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

if (nrow(product)) {
  pm <- as.matrix(product[, gene_cols, drop = FALSE]); rownames(pm) <- product$ID
  hits <- colnames(pm)[colSums(pm > 0) > 0]
  cat("\n--- markers detected in the sequenced ProPrems product (n = ",
      nrow(product), ") ---\n", sep = "")
  print(data.frame(marker    = sub("\\|.*", "", hits),
                   subfamily = sub(".*gene_subfamily=([^|]*).*", "\\1", hits),
                   t(round(pm[, hits, drop = FALSE], 2))), row.names = FALSE)
}

## ---- STEP 7. Figure ---------------------------------------------------------
FIG <- "1F"   # change to "1G" if the panel is renumbered; used for filenames

focus_cols <- vapply(FOCUS, function(f) {
  hit <- grep(f, gene_cols, value = TRUE); stopifnot(length(hit) == 1); hit

plot_df <- base_df %>%

fmt_p <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA",
                     ifelse(x < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("%.3f", x)))

## FDR from the abundance half of the two-part screen.
lab_abund <- results_bsh %>%
  filter(Part == "Abundance", Marker_id %in% FOCUS) %>%
  transmute(panel = factor(Marker_id, levels = FOCUS,
                           labels = FOCUS_LABELS[FOCUS]),
            label = ifelse(is.na(P), "", paste0("FDR = ", fmt_p(FDR))))

## Detection counts are still computed — they are the numbers for the text, and
## they identify any group with nothing to plot.
det_df <- plot_df %>%

## Groups with no detected samples get an explicit annotation, not a blank gap.

p_fig <- plot_df %>%
```
