```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FIGURE 1G — complete pipeline
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(reshape2)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# plyr / plotly / lmerTest mask dplyr verbs — pin them
select    <- dplyr::select
filter    <- dplyr::filter
mutate    <- dplyr::mutate
summarise <- dplyr::summarise
arrange   <- dplyr::arrange
rename    <- dplyr::rename
group_by  <- dplyr::group_by
count     <- dplyr::count

META_FILE <- "meta_with_placental_subtypes.txt"

# ── Screening thresholds ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Two rules, both counted by distinct infant. A categorical phenotype is
# modelled only if BOTH hold; continuous phenotypes need only MIN_TOTAL_INFANTS.
MIN_LEVEL_INFANTS  <- 5      # distinct infants required in EACH level
MIN_TOTAL_INFANTS  <- 10     # distinct infants required for a continuous phenotype
MAX_MAJORITY_SHARE <- 0.95   # largest level may hold at most this share of infants
                             # (the LLNEXT pipeline's minimum_variance = 5)

# Declared factor level that never occurs in the data (e.g. "diffuse"
# chorangiosis, absent from this export):
#   "drop_level"  -> remove it, model the remaining levels
#   "drop_factor" -> do not model the phenotype at all
EMPTY_LEVEL_ACTION <- "drop_level"

# ── Identifiers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# "ID" is the SAMPLE identifier (577 infant rows, 577 unique values); "MM_ID" is
# the INFANT identifier (133 infants). mixed_models() uses its `ID` argument
# only to set row names before merging with the CLR table, so it must be the
# sample id. The random intercept is (1|MM_ID) inside the function, so repeated
# sampling is handled there; INFANT_ID is used by the screen.
INFANT_ID <- "MM_ID"
SAMPLE_ID <- "ID"

# Print every row whether the object is a tibble or a plain data.frame.
# (print(n = Inf) on a data.frame partially matches 'na.print' and errors.)
print_all <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) { cat("  (none)\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  print(as.data.frame(df), row.names = FALSE)
  invisible(NULL)
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LABELS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Every variable in pheno_list has an entry; the check before plotting warns
# about any that do not.
PHENOTYPE_LABELS <- c(
  # ── maternal / obstetric ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "prolonged_rupt"    = "Prolonged Rupture of Membranes",
  "multiple"          = "Multiple Pregnancy",
  "delivery_md"       = "Delivery Mode",
  "maternal_atb"      = "Maternal Antibiotics",
  "maternal_ab48"     = "Maternal Antibiotics (48h)",
  "mother_st"         = "Antenatal Corticosteroids (any)",
  "mother_st_com"     = "Antenatal Corticosteroids (complete)",
  "pe_hellp"          = "Pre-eclampsia / HELLP",
  "maternal_infect"   = "Maternal Infection",
  "mother_b_hem"      = "Maternal Group B Streptococcus",
  "primiparous"       = "Primiparous",
  "parities_nb"       = "Parity",

  # ── infant characteristics ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "ga_exact"          = "Gestational Age",
  "bw"                = "Birth Weight",
  "sex"               = "Sex",
  "apgar_1"           = "Apgar Score (1 min)",
  "apgar_5"           = "Apgar Score (5 min)",
  "SGA"               = "Small for Gestational Age",
  "LGA"               = "Large for Gestational Age",
  "FGR"               = "Fetal Growth Restriction",
  "admissiontime"     = "Admission Duration",
  "week"              = "Postnatal Week",
  "Postnatal_Age"     = "Postnatal Age",

  # ── treatment / exposure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "ab48"              = "Antibiotics in First 48h",
  "abtx"              = "Antibiotic Treatment",
  "antibiotic_sample" = "Days of Antibiotic Use",
  "antibiotic"        = "Days of Antibiotic Use",
  "probiotics"        = "Probiotics",
  "probiotic_sample"  = "Days of Probiotic Use",
  "probiotics_sample" = "Days of Probiotic Use",
  "tpn_days"          = "Duration of Parenteral Nutrition",
  "TFEF"              = "Time to Full Enteral Feeds",
  "TFEF_B"            = "Time to Full Enteral Feeds (dichotomised)",
  "mmpercentage"      = "Mother's Own Milk (%)",
  "surgery"           = "Surgery",
  "surgery_nec"       = "Surgery for NEC",
  "rbc_tx_48"         = "Red Cell Transfusion (48h)",

  # ── outcomes / morbidity ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "nec"               = "Necrotizing Enterocolitis",
  "nec_bell"          = "NEC (Bell Stage)",
  "sip"               = "Spontaneous Intestinal Perforation",
  "sepsis"            = "Sepsis",
  "sepsis_culture"    = "Culture-proven Sepsis",
  "sepsis_crp"        = "Sepsis (CRP-defined)",
  "pda"               = "Patent Ductus Arteriosus",
  "pda_sign"          = "Haemodynamically Significant PDA",
  "ivh"               = "Intraventricular Haemorrhage",
  "mortality"         = "Mortality",

  # ── placental pathology ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "mvm"               = "Maternal Vascular Malperfusion",
  "fvm"               = "Fetal Vascular Malperfusion",
  "fh"                = "Increased Nucleated Fetal Erythrocytes",
  "hypoplasia"        = "Placental Hypoplasia (weight <p10)",
  "placenta_ab"       = "Any Placental Abnormality",
  "placental_weight"  = "Placental Weight",
  "fvm_high_grade"    = "Fetal Vascular Malperfusion (High Grade)",
  "vue_high_grade"    = "Villitis of Unknown Aetiology (High Grade)",
  "fvm_type"          = "Fetal Vascular Malperfusion",
  "ch_type"           = "Chorangiosis",
  "ca_type"           = "Chorioamnionitis",
  "vue_type"          = "Villitis of Unknown Aetiology"
)

# Pretty forms for subtype levels, used for "<base>__<level>" contrast names.
LEVEL_LABELS <- c(
  "low grade"                   = "Low Grade",
  "high grade"                  = "High Grade",
  "segmental"                   = "Segmental",
  "diffuse"                     = "Diffuse",
  "maternal response only"      = "Maternal Response Only",
  "maternal and fetal response" = "Maternal and Fetal Response"
)

# Exact match; else "<base>__<level>" assembled from both maps; else title-case
# (and reported, so nothing reaches the figure unnoticed).
clean_phenotype_name <- function(name) {
  vapply(name, function(nm) {
    if (nm %in% names(PHENOTYPE_LABELS)) return(unname(PHENOTYPE_LABELS[nm]))
    if (grepl("__", nm, fixed = TRUE)) {
      parts <- strsplit(nm, "__", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      base  <- parts[1]
      lvl   <- paste(parts[-1], collapse = "__")
      base_lab <- if (base %in% names(PHENOTYPE_LABELS))
        unname(PHENOTYPE_LABELS[base]) else tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", base))
      lvl_lab  <- if (lvl %in% names(LEVEL_LABELS))
        unname(LEVEL_LABELS[lvl]) else tools::toTitleCase(lvl)
      return(sprintf("%s (%s)", base_lab, lvl_lab))
    }
    stripped <- gsub("_sample$", "", nm)
    if (stripped %in% names(PHENOTYPE_LABELS))
      return(unname(PHENOTYPE_LABELS[stripped]))
    tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", nm))
  }, FUN.VALUE = character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1 — read metadata, restrict to infant samples
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# write.table() output: whitespace separated, quoted, with a leading row-name
# column that read.table() consumes automatically. quote = "\"" is required
# because several placental levels contain spaces ("maternal response only").
metadata_all <- read.table(META_FILE, header = TRUE, quote = "\"",
                           na.strings = c("NA", ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                           comment.char = "")

cat(sprintf("Read %d rows x %d columns from %s\n",
            nrow(metadata_all), ncol(metadata_all), META_FILE))
cat("SampleType breakdown:\n"); print(table(metadata_all$SampleType, useNA = "ifany"))

metadata_infant <- metadata_all[metadata_all$SampleType == "infant", , drop = FALSE]
rownames(metadata_infant) <- metadata_infant[[SAMPLE_ID]]

cat(sprintf("\nInfant samples: %d   distinct infants: %d   median samples/infant: %.0f\n",
            nrow(metadata_infant),
            dplyr::n_distinct(metadata_infant[[INFANT_ID]]),
            median(table(metadata_infant[[INFANT_ID]]))))

# mixed_models() sets row.names from its ID argument, so it must be unique per
# row; it hardcodes (1|MM_ID) and Postnatal_Age, so those must exist.
if (anyDuplicated(metadata_infant[[SAMPLE_ID]]))
  stop("SAMPLE_ID is not unique per row — mixed_models() will fail on row.names.")
for (needed in c("MM_ID", "Postnatal_Age", "Clean_reads_P1", "DNA_conc")) {
  if (!needed %in% colnames(metadata_infant))
    stop("mixed_models() requires the column '", needed, "', which is not in the metadata.")
}
if (max(table(metadata_infant[[INFANT_ID]])) < 2)
  warning("Every infant has a single sample — (1|MM_ID) will be singular.", call. = FALSE)

# ── Pin reference levels for the subtype factors ──────────────────────────────
# Without this the factors take the default alphabetical reference (e.g.
# "maternal and fetal response" sorts before "none"), which is clinically
# backwards.
subtype_levels <- list(
  fvm_type = c("none", "low grade", "high grade"),
  ch_type  = c("none", "segmental", "diffuse"),
  ca_type  = c("none", "maternal response only", "maternal and fetal response"),
  vue_type = c("none", "low grade", "high grade")
)
for (v in names(subtype_levels)) {
  if (!v %in% colnames(metadata_infant)) { cat("!! missing column:", v, "\n"); next }
  unmatched <- setdiff(unique(na.omit(as.character(metadata_infant[[v]]))),
                       subtype_levels[[v]])
  if (length(unmatched) > 0)
    warning(sprintf("%s: values not in the declared levels become NA -> %s",
                    v, paste(unmatched, collapse = "; ")), call. = FALSE)
  metadata_infant[[v]] <- factor(metadata_infant[[v]], levels = subtype_levels[[v]])
}

# FVM/VUE collapsed to "high grade present" (1) vs everything else (0), with
# "none" and "low grade" both in the reference. NA stays NA (not assessed).
metadata_infant$fvm_high_grade <- ifelse(
  is.na(metadata_infant$fvm_type), NA_real_,
  as.numeric(as.character(metadata_infant$fvm_type) == "high grade")
)
metadata_infant$vue_high_grade <- ifelse(
  is.na(metadata_infant$vue_type), NA_real_,
  as.numeric(as.character(metadata_infant$vue_type) == "high grade")
)

pheno_list <- c(
  "prolonged_rupt", "mmpercentage", "surgery", "ab48", "apgar_1",
  "apgar_5", "multiple", "delivery_md", "maternal_atb", "mother_st_com",
  "pe_hellp", "maternal_infect", "mother_b_hem",
  "antibiotic_sample", "probiotic_sample", "ga_exact", "bw", "nec",
  "sex", "admissiontime", "tpn_days", "sip", "sepsis_culture",
  "pda_sign", "mortality", "week", "probiotics", "SGA",
  "LGA", "FGR", "TFEF_B", "TFEF", "ivh", "abtx",
  # ── placental pathology ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # placenta_ab dropped, as in the binary version. ch/ca as subtype factors;
  # fvm/vue as the "high grade present" binaries above; mvm, fh and hypoplasia
  # have no subtype breakdown. dvi/chiv/mfi/mpvfd are all-zero in this export.
  "mvm", "fh", "hypoplasia", "fvm_high_grade", "vue_high_grade",
  "ch_type", "ca_type"
)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 2 — screen phenotypes on number of infants per level
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Categorical = factor / character / logical, or numeric with <= 2 distinct
# values (0/1 flags). Numeric with more distinct values (ga_exact, bw, apgar_1,
# tpn_days, TFEF, week, ...) is continuous; the per-level rule does not apply.
is_categorical_pheno <- function(x) {
  if (is.factor(x) || is.character(x) || is.logical(x)) return(TRUE)
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) <= 2)
  TRUE
}

build_infant_level_counts <- function(metadata, phenos, id_col = INFANT_ID,
                                      min_level_n = MIN_LEVEL_INFANTS,
                                      min_total_n = MIN_TOTAL_INFANTS) {
  map_dfr(intersect(phenos, colnames(metadata)), function(pheno) {
    raw <- metadata[[pheno]]
    ok  <- !is.na(raw)
    ids <- metadata[[id_col]][ok]
    if (!is_categorical_pheno(raw)) {
      n_inf <- dplyr::n_distinct(ids)
      return(tibble(Phenotype = pheno, Type = "continuous", Level = NA_character_,
                    n_samples = sum(ok), n_infants = n_inf,
                    Below_min = n_inf < min_total_n))
    }
    v  <- raw[ok]
    lv <- if (is.factor(v)) levels(v) else sort(unique(as.character(v)))
    map_dfr(lv, function(l) {
      sel   <- !is.na(as.character(v)) & as.character(v) == l
      n_inf <- dplyr::n_distinct(ids[sel])
      tibble(Phenotype = pheno, Type = "categorical", Level = as.character(l),
             n_samples = sum(sel), n_infants = n_inf,
             Below_min = n_inf < min_level_n)
    })
  }) %>% arrange(Phenotype, desc(n_infants))
}

screen_phenotypes <- function(metadata, phenos, id_col = INFANT_ID,
                              min_level_n        = MIN_LEVEL_INFANTS,
                              min_total_n        = MIN_TOTAL_INFANTS,
                              max_majority       = MAX_MAJORITY_SHARE,
                              empty_level_action = EMPTY_LEVEL_ACTION) {
  keep    <- character(0)
  dropped <- list()
  note <- function(pheno, rule, reason, detail = NA_character_) {
    dropped[[length(dropped) + 1]] <<- tibble(
      Phenotype = pheno, Rule = rule, Reason = reason, Detail = detail)
    invisible(NULL)
  }

  for (pheno in phenos) {
    if (!pheno %in% colnames(metadata)) { note(pheno, "-", "not in metadata"); next }

    raw <- metadata[[pheno]]
    ok  <- !is.na(raw)
    ids <- metadata[[id_col]][ok]
    n_inf_tot <- dplyr::n_distinct(ids)

    if (!is_categorical_pheno(raw)) {
      if (n_inf_tot < min_total_n) {
        note(pheno, "group size", "too few infants",
             sprintf("%d infants (< %d)", n_inf_tot, min_total_n)); next
      }
      if (length(unique(raw[ok])) < 2) { note(pheno, "variance", "no variation"); next }
      keep <- c(keep, pheno); next
    }

    v <- raw[ok]
    if (!is.factor(v)) v <- factor(v)

    empty_levels <- setdiff(levels(v), unique(as.character(v)))
    if (length(empty_levels) > 0) {
      if (identical(empty_level_action, "drop_factor")) {
        note(pheno, "group size", "level never observed",
             paste(empty_levels, collapse = "; ")); next
      }
      v <- droplevels(v)   # also keeps the model matrix full rank
      col <- metadata[[pheno]]
      if (is.factor(col)) metadata[[pheno]] <- droplevels(col)
    }

    inf_per_level <- vapply(levels(v), function(l)
      dplyr::n_distinct(ids[as.character(v) == l]), integer(1))
    detail <- paste(sprintf("%s=%d infants", names(inf_per_level), inf_per_level),
                    collapse = ", ")

    if (length(inf_per_level) < 2) {
      note(pheno, "group size", "only one level present", detail); next
    }

    # ---- RULE 1: >= min_level_n distinct infants in EVERY level -------------
    if (any(inf_per_level < min_level_n)) {
      note(pheno, "group size", sprintf("level with < %d infants", min_level_n),
           detail); next
    }

    # ---- RULE 2: the largest level holds <= max_majority of infants ---------
    if (max(inf_per_level) / n_inf_tot > max_majority) {
      note(pheno, "variance",
           sprintf("largest level %.1g%% of infants (> %.0f%%)",
                   100 * max(inf_per_level) / n_inf_tot, 100 * max_majority),
           detail); next
    }

    keep <- c(keep, pheno)
  }

  list(keep    = keep,
       dropped = if (length(dropped)) bind_rows(dropped) else tibble(),
       metadata = metadata)
}

pheno_counts_by_level <- build_infant_level_counts(metadata_infant, pheno_list)
write.table(pheno_counts_by_level, "1G_pheno_level_counts.txt",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

screen          <- screen_phenotypes(metadata_infant, pheno_list)
metadata_infant <- screen$metadata
pheno_list_kept <- screen$keep

write.table(screen$dropped, "1G_pheno_screening_dropped.txt",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("\nPhenotypes requested: %d   modelled: %d   excluded: %d\n",
            length(pheno_list), length(pheno_list_kept), nrow(screen$dropped)))
cat("\n--- Excluded, by rule ---\n")
print_all(screen$dropped)
if (nrow(screen$dropped) > 0) {
  cat("\n--- Exclusion counts ---\n")
  screen$dropped %>% dplyr::count(Rule, Reason) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% print_all()
}

cat("\n--- Placental phenotypes: infants per level ---\n")
pheno_counts_by_level %>%
  filter(Phenotype %in% c("mvm", "fh", "hypoplasia", "fvm_high_grade",
                          "vue_high_grade", "ch_type", "ca_type")) %>%
  print_all()
cat("\n")

if (length(pheno_list_kept) == 0)
  stop("No phenotype passed the screen — check INFANT_ID and the thresholds.")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 3 — mixed models
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
shared <- intersect(rownames(metadata_infant), rownames(taxa_sp_filt_CLR))
cat(sprintf("Samples shared with taxa table: %d (metadata %d, taxa %d)\n",
            length(shared), nrow(metadata_infant), nrow(taxa_sp_filt_CLR)))
metadata_model <- metadata_infant[shared, , drop = FALSE]

# SAMPLE_ID, not INFANT_ID: the function keys row names on this argument.
# The random intercept (1|MM_ID) is applied internally.
taxa_sp_mixed_all <- mixed_models(metadata_model, SAMPLE_ID,
                                  taxa_sp_filt_CLR[shared, , drop = FALSE],
                                  pheno_list_kept)

stopifnot(all(unique(taxa_sp_mixed_all$Pheno) %in% pheno_list_kept))

# ── FDR over unique tests, not coefficient rows ───────────────────────────────
# mixed_models() returns one row per COEFFICIENT but assigns the same term-level
# LRT p-value to each. A multi-level factor such as ca_type therefore enters the
# BH correction once per contrast, inflating the denominator beyond the number
# of tests actually performed. Adjust over unique (Bug, Pheno) tests and map
# back. FDR_orig keeps the original values for comparison.
taxa_sp_mixed_all <- taxa_sp_mixed_all %>%
  group_by(Bug, Pheno) %>%
  mutate(P_term = dplyr::first(P)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(FDR_orig = FDR)

fdr_lookup <- taxa_sp_mixed_all %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Bug, Pheno, P_term) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(P_term, method = "BH"))

taxa_sp_mixed_all <- taxa_sp_mixed_all %>%
  dplyr::select(-FDR) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(fdr_lookup, by = c("Bug", "Pheno", "P_term"))

cat(sprintf("\nCoefficient rows: %d   unique (taxon, phenotype) tests: %d\n",
            nrow(taxa_sp_mixed_all), nrow(fdr_lookup)))
cat(sprintf("Hits at FDR < 0.05  —  recomputed: %d   original: %d\n",
            sum(taxa_sp_mixed_all$FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(taxa_sp_mixed_all$FDR_orig < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)))

write.table(taxa_sp_mixed_all, "taxa_sp_mixed_all_pl_subtypes.txt",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("✓ Models run for %d phenotypes; every categorical level has >= %d infants\n\n",
            length(pheno_list_kept), MIN_LEVEL_INFANTS))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 4 — Figure 1G
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
taxa_sp_mixed <- read.delim("taxa_sp_mixed_all_pl_subtypes.txt")

# Multi-level factors yield one coefficient row per non-reference level, all
# sharing the same Pheno. Folding the level into the phenotype identity
# ("ca_type__maternal response only") keeps each contrast on its own row so the
# dcast() pivot never collides — otherwise dcast falls back to counting rows and
# the heatmap comes out as a near-uniform block.
# substring() is vectorised element-wise over `first`; sub()'s `pattern` is not.
subtype_phenos <- c("ch_type", "ca_type", "fvm_type", "vue_type")

taxa_sp_mixed <- taxa_sp_mixed %>%
  dplyr::select(Feature, Bug, Pheno, t.value, P, FDR) %>%
  dplyr::rename(bac = Bug, phenotype = Pheno) %>%
  mutate(level = ifelse(phenotype %in% subtype_phenos,
                        trimws(substring(Feature, nchar(phenotype) + 1)),
                        NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(is.na(level) | level != "none") %>%
  mutate(phenotype = ifelse(!is.na(level), paste0(phenotype, "__", level), phenotype)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Feature, -level)

taxa_sp_mixed_filtered <- taxa_sp_mixed %>% filter(FDR < 0.05)

pheno_counts <- taxa_sp_mixed_filtered %>% count(phenotype) %>% arrange(desc(n))

# Phenotypes excluded from the figure by hand. sip is already removed by the
# infant-count screen; probiotic_sample duplicates probiotics; maternal_viral
# is not a column in this export, so that entry has never matched anything.
MANUAL_EXCLUSIONS <- c("probiotic_sample", "maternal_viral", "sip")
pheno_counts <- pheno_counts %>% filter(!phenotype %in% MANUAL_EXCLUSIONS)

cat("\n--- Significant taxa per phenotype (FDR < 0.05), full ranking ---\n")
pheno_counts %>%
  mutate(label = clean_phenotype_name(phenotype)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% print(row.names = FALSE)

N_TOP     <- 10
top_pheno <- pheno_counts %>% slice_max(n, n = N_TOP, with_ties = FALSE)

if (nrow(pheno_counts) > N_TOP) {
  cat(sprintf("\nCut at %d of %d phenotypes: last included n = %d, first excluded n = %d\n",
              N_TOP, nrow(pheno_counts), min(top_pheno$n), pheno_counts$n[N_TOP + 1]))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("\nOnly %d phenotypes have any FDR < 0.05 association — all are shown; the top-%d cut never binds.\n",
              nrow(pheno_counts), N_TOP))
}

top_phenotypes    <- unique(top_pheno$phenotype)
included_bacteria <- unique(taxa_sp_mixed_filtered$bac)

taxa_sp_filtered <- taxa_sp_mixed %>%
  filter(bac %in% included_bacteria, phenotype %in% top_phenotypes)

# ── Wide matrices ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
wide_data <- dcast(taxa_sp_filtered, phenotype ~ bac, value.var = 't.value')
row.names(wide_data) <- wide_data$phenotype
wide_data$phenotype  <- NULL
wide_data[is.na(wide_data)] <- 0

significance_matrix <- dcast(taxa_sp_filtered, phenotype ~ bac, value.var = 'FDR')
row.names(significance_matrix) <- significance_matrix$phenotype
significance_matrix$phenotype  <- NULL
significance_matrix <- ifelse(!is.na(significance_matrix) & significance_matrix < 0.05,
                              '*', '')

heatmap_data <- as.matrix(wide_data)

# Keep the two matrices in lockstep so the asterisks cannot drift.
significance_matrix <- significance_matrix[rownames(heatmap_data),
                                           colnames(heatmap_data), drop = FALSE]

# ── Apply labels, refusing to plot a raw variable name ────────────────────────
raw_rows  <- rownames(heatmap_data)
new_names <- clean_phenotype_name(raw_rows)

unlabelled <- raw_rows[!(raw_rows %in% names(PHENOTYPE_LABELS)) &
                         !grepl("__", raw_rows, fixed = TRUE)]
if (length(unlabelled) > 0)
  warning("No label defined for: ", paste(unlabelled, collapse = ", "),
          " — add them to PHENOTYPE_LABELS.", call. = FALSE)

if (anyDuplicated(new_names))
  stop("Two phenotypes resolve to the same label: ",
       paste(unique(new_names[duplicated(new_names)]), collapse = ", "))

rownames(heatmap_data)        <- new_names
rownames(significance_matrix) <- new_names

cat("\n--- Row labels on the figure ---\n")
print(data.frame(variable = raw_rows, label = new_names), row.names = FALSE)

# ── Draw ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
custom_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50)
max_abs_value <- max(abs(heatmap_data), na.rm = TRUE)
breaks_list   <- seq(-max_abs_value, max_abs_value, length.out = 50)

pheatmap(
  heatmap_data,
  cluster_rows             = FALSE,
  cluster_cols             = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_rows = 'euclidean',
  clustering_method        = 'complete',
  color                    = custom_colors,
  breaks                   = breaks_list,
  display_numbers          = significance_matrix,
  number_color             = "black",
  fontsize_number          = 14,
  main                     = '',
  angle_col                = 90,
  fontsize_col             = 9,
  fontsize_row             = 10,
  cellheight               = 15,
  cellwidth                = 15,
  filename                 = "1G_phenotype_heatmap_subtypes.pdf"
)

cat("✓ Saved: 1G_phenotype_heatmap_subtypes.pdf\n")
```

```{r}
  "ga_exact"          = "Gestational Age",
  "bw"                = "Birth Weight",
  "sex"               = "Sex",
  "apgar_1"           = "Apgar Score (1 min)",
  "apgar_5"           = "Apgar Score (5 min)",
  "SGA"               = "Small for Gestational Age",
  "LGA"               = "Large for Gestational Age",
  "FGR"               = "Fetal Growth Restriction",
  "admissiontime"     = "Admission Duration",
  "week"              = "Postnatal Week",
  "Postnatal_Age"     = "Postnatal Age",

  # ── treatment / exposure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "ab48"              = "Antibiotics in First 48h",
  "abtx"              = "Antibiotic Treatment",
  "antibiotic_sample" = "Days of Antibiotic Use",
  "antibiotic"        = "Days of Antibiotic Use",
  "probiotics"        = "Probiotics",
  "probiotic_sample"  = "Days of Probiotic Use",
  "probiotics_sample" = "Days of Probiotic Use",
  "tpn_days"          = "Duration of Parenteral Nutrition",
  "TFEF"              = "Time to Full Enteral Feeds",
  "TFEF_B"            = "Time to Full Enteral Feeds (dichotomised)",
  "mmpercentage"      = "Mother's Own Milk (%)",
  "surgery"           = "Surgery",
  "surgery_nec"       = "Surgery for NEC",
  "rbc_tx_48"         = "Red Cell Transfusion (48h)",

  # ── outcomes / morbidity ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "nec"               = "Necrotizing Enterocolitis",
  "nec_bell"          = "NEC (Bell Stage)",
  "sip"               = "Spontaneous Intestinal Perforation",
  "sepsis"            = "Sepsis",
  "sepsis_culture"    = "Culture-proven Sepsis",
  "sepsis_crp"        = "Sepsis (CRP-defined)",
  "pda"               = "Patent Ductus Arteriosus",
  "pda_sign"          = "Haemodynamically Significant PDA",
  "ivh"               = "Intraventricular Haemorrhage",
  "mortality"         = "Mortality",

  # ── placental pathology ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "mvm"               = "Maternal Vascular Malperfusion",
  "fvm"               = "Fetal Vascular Malperfusion",
  "fh"                = "Increased Nucleated Fetal Erythrocytes",
  "hypoplasia"        = "Placental Hypoplasia (weight <p10)",
  "placenta_ab"       = "Any Placental Abnormality",
  "placental_weight"  = "Placental Weight",
  "fvm_high_grade"    = "Fetal Vascular Malperfusion (High Grade)",
  "vue_high_grade"    = "Villitis of Unknown Aetiology (High Grade)",
  "fvm_type"          = "Fetal Vascular Malperfusion",
  "ch_type"           = "Chorangiosis",
  "ca_type"           = "Chorioamnionitis",
  "vue_type"          = "Villitis of Unknown Aetiology"
)

# Pretty forms for subtype levels, used when a phenotype is written as
# "<base>__<level>" by the contrast-splitting step above.
LEVEL_LABELS <- c(
  "low grade"                   = "Low Grade",
  "high grade"                  = "High Grade",
  "segmental"                   = "Segmental",
  "diffuse"                     = "Diffuse",
  "maternal response only"      = "Maternal Response Only",
  "maternal and fetal response" = "Maternal and Fetal Response"
)

# ── Resolver ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Handles three cases: an exact match; a "<base>__<level>" contrast, which is
# assembled from the base label and the level label; and anything unrecognised,
# which is title-cased AND reported, rather than reaching the figure unnoticed.
clean_phenotype_name <- function(name) {
  vapply(name, function(nm) {
    if (nm %in% names(PHENOTYPE_LABELS)) return(unname(PHENOTYPE_LABELS[nm]))

    if (grepl("__", nm, fixed = TRUE)) {
      parts <- strsplit(nm, "__", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      base  <- parts[1]
      lvl   <- paste(parts[-1], collapse = "__")
      base_lab <- if (base %in% names(PHENOTYPE_LABELS))
        unname(PHENOTYPE_LABELS[base]) else tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", base))
      lvl_lab  <- if (lvl %in% names(LEVEL_LABELS))
        unname(LEVEL_LABELS[lvl]) else tools::toTitleCase(lvl)
      return(sprintf("%s (%s)", base_lab, lvl_lab))
    }

    stripped <- gsub("_sample$", "", nm)
    if (stripped %in% names(PHENOTYPE_LABELS))
      return(unname(PHENOTYPE_LABELS[stripped]))

    tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", nm))
  }, FUN.VALUE = character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Figure 1G
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
taxa_sp_mixed <- read.delim("taxa_sp_mixed_all_pl_subtypes.txt")

# Multi-level factors yield one coefficient row per non-reference level, all
# sharing the same Pheno. Folding the level into the phenotype identity
# ("ca_type__maternal response only") keeps each contrast on its own row so the
# dcast() pivot never collides. substring() is vectorised element-wise over
# `first`, so each row strips its own prefix.
subtype_phenos <- c("ch_type", "ca_type", "fvm_type", "vue_type")

taxa_sp_mixed <- taxa_sp_mixed %>%
  dplyr::select(Feature, Bug, Pheno, t.value, P, FDR) %>%
  dplyr::rename(bac = Bug, phenotype = Pheno) %>%
  mutate(
    level = ifelse(phenotype %in% subtype_phenos,
                   trimws(substring(Feature, nchar(phenotype) + 1)),
                   NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.na(level) | level != "none") %>%
  mutate(phenotype = ifelse(!is.na(level), paste0(phenotype, "__", level), phenotype)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Feature, -level)

taxa_sp_mixed_filtered <- taxa_sp_mixed %>% filter(FDR < 0.05)

pheno_counts <- taxa_sp_mixed_filtered %>%
  dplyr::count(phenotype) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

# Phenotypes excluded from the figure by hand. sip is already removed by the
# infant-count screen; probiotic_sample duplicates probiotics; maternal_viral
# is not a column in this export, so that entry has never matched anything.
MANUAL_EXCLUSIONS <- c("probiotic_sample", "maternal_viral", "sip")
pheno_counts <- pheno_counts %>% filter(!phenotype %in% MANUAL_EXCLUSIONS)

# Report the full ranking, so the inclusion cut is visible rather than implied.
cat("\n--- Significant taxa per phenotype (FDR < 0.05), full ranking ---\n")
pheno_counts %>%
  mutate(label = clean_phenotype_name(phenotype)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print(row.names = FALSE)

N_TOP <- 10
# with_ties = TRUE: when phenotypes tie on n at the cut-off, every tied
# phenotype is kept rather than an arbitrary subset chosen by sort order.
# In the current data four phenotypes tie at n = 5 for the last three slots
# (antibiotic treatment, maternal GBS, birth weight, admission duration), so
# the figure shows 11 rows rather than 10. Dropping one of four equally
# supported variables on sort order alone is not defensible in a figure.
top_pheno <- pheno_counts %>% slice_max(n, n = N_TOP, with_ties = TRUE)

cutoff_n <- min(top_pheno$n)
n_tied   <- sum(pheno_counts$n == cutoff_n)
excluded <- pheno_counts %>% filter(!phenotype %in% top_pheno$phenotype)

cat(sprintf("\nPhenotypes with >= 1 association at FDR < 0.05: %d\n", nrow(pheno_counts)))
cat(sprintf("Shown in the figure: %d (top %d requested; %d phenotype(s) tied at n = %d, all kept)\n",
            nrow(top_pheno), N_TOP, n_tied, cutoff_n))
if (nrow(excluded) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("Highest excluded: %s (n = %d)\n", excluded$phenotype[1], excluded$n[1]))
} else {
  cat("Nothing excluded — every phenotype with an association is shown.\n")
}

top_phenotypes    <- unique(top_pheno$phenotype)
included_bacteria <- unique(taxa_sp_mixed_filtered$bac)

taxa_sp_filtered <- taxa_sp_mixed %>%
  filter(bac %in% included_bacteria, phenotype %in% top_phenotypes)

# ── Wide matrices ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
wide_data <- dcast(taxa_sp_filtered, phenotype ~ bac, value.var = 't.value')
row.names(wide_data) <- wide_data$phenotype
wide_data$phenotype  <- NULL
wide_data[is.na(wide_data)] <- 0

significance_matrix <- dcast(taxa_sp_filtered, phenotype ~ bac, value.var = 'FDR')
row.names(significance_matrix) <- significance_matrix$phenotype
significance_matrix$phenotype  <- NULL
significance_matrix <- ifelse(!is.na(significance_matrix) & significance_matrix < 0.05,
                              '*', '')

heatmap_data <- as.matrix(wide_data)

# Keep the two matrices in the same row/column order: pheatmap places the
# asterisks by position.
significance_matrix <- significance_matrix[rownames(heatmap_data),
                                           colnames(heatmap_data), drop = FALSE]

# ── Apply labels, and refuse to plot a raw variable name ──────────────────────
raw_rows  <- rownames(heatmap_data)
new_names <- clean_phenotype_name(raw_rows)

unlabelled <- raw_rows[
  !(raw_rows %in% names(PHENOTYPE_LABELS)) & !grepl("__", raw_rows, fixed = TRUE)
]
if (length(unlabelled) > 0)
  warning("No label defined for: ", paste(unlabelled, collapse = ", "),
          " — add them to PHENOTYPE_LABELS.", call. = FALSE)

if (anyDuplicated(new_names))
  stop("Two phenotypes resolve to the same label: ",
       paste(unique(new_names[duplicated(new_names)]), collapse = ", "))

rownames(heatmap_data)        <- new_names
rownames(significance_matrix) <- new_names

cat("\n--- Row labels on the figure ---\n")
print(data.frame(variable = raw_rows, label = new_names), row.names = FALSE)

# ── Draw ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(RColorBrewer)
custom_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50)
max_abs_value <- max(abs(heatmap_data), na.rm = TRUE)
breaks_list   <- seq(-max_abs_value, max_abs_value, length.out = 50)

pheatmap(
  heatmap_data,
  cluster_rows             = FALSE,
  cluster_cols             = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_rows = 'euclidean',
  clustering_method        = 'complete',
  color                    = custom_colors,
  breaks                   = breaks_list,
  display_numbers          = significance_matrix,
  number_color             = "black",
  fontsize_number          = 14,
  main                     = '',
  angle_col                = 90,
  fontsize_col             = 9,
  fontsize_row             = 10,
  cellheight               = 15,
  cellwidth                = 15,
  filename                 = "1G_phenotype_heatmap_subtypes.pdf"
)

cat("✓ Saved: 1G_phenotype_heatmap_subtypes.pdf\n")

# ── LEGEND NUMBERS: Fig. 1g ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Needs metadata_model and fdr_lookup from the full Figure 1G chunk above.
legend_out("Fig 1g — samples / infants entering the mixed models",
           metadata_model %>% mutate(MM_ID = as.numeric(MM_ID)) %>% n_si())
legend_out("Fig 1g — BH family",
           sprintf("taxa tested: %d | phenotypes tested: %d | unique taxon x phenotype tests: %d",
                   dplyr::n_distinct(fdr_lookup$Bug), dplyr::n_distinct(fdr_lookup$Pheno),
                   nrow(fdr_lookup)))
legend_out("Fig 1g — shown",
           sprintf("phenotype rows: %d (top %d by number of FDR<0.05 taxa, ties kept; manually excluded: %s) | species columns: %d (any FDR<0.05 association)",
                   nrow(heatmap_data), N_TOP, paste(MANUAL_EXCLUSIONS, collapse = ", "),
                   ncol(heatmap_data)))
covs_1g <- c("Clean_reads_P1", "DNA_conc", "Postnatal_Age")
legend_out("Fig 1g — complete cases per shown phenotype (samples; infants)",
           purrr::map_dfr(unique(sub("__.*$", "", top_phenotypes)), function(ph) {
             ok <- stats::complete.cases(metadata_model[, c(ph, covs_1g), drop = FALSE])
             tibble(Phenotype = clean_phenotype_name(ph),
                    n_samples = sum(ok),
                    n_infants = dplyr::n_distinct(metadata_model$MM_ID[ok]))
           }))
```

```{r}
#VIF

META_FILE <- "meta_with_placental_subtypes.txt"
SAMPLE_ID <- "ID"
INFANT_ID <- "MM_ID"
COVARIATES <- c("Clean_reads_P1", "DNA_conc", "Postnatal_Age")

if (!exists("top_pheno")) stop("Run the Figure 1G block first — `top_pheno` is missing.")

heatmap_phenos <- unique(sub("__.*$", "", top_pheno$phenotype))
cat("Variables shown in Figure 1G:\n  ", paste(heatmap_phenos, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

# ── Rebuild the modelling table ───────────────────────────────────────────────
meta_all <- read.table(META_FILE, header = TRUE, quote = "\"",
                       na.strings = c("NA", ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                       comment.char = "")
meta <- meta_all[meta_all$SampleType == "infant", , drop = FALSE]
rownames(meta) <- meta[[SAMPLE_ID]]

# Same reference levels as the models, so factor coding matches.
subtype_levels <- list(
  fvm_type = c("none", "low grade", "high grade"),
  ch_type  = c("none", "segmental", "diffuse"),
  ca_type  = c("none", "maternal response only", "maternal and fetal response"),
  vue_type = c("none", "low grade", "high grade")
)
for (v in names(subtype_levels))
  if (v %in% colnames(meta))
    meta[[v]] <- factor(meta[[v]], levels = subtype_levels[[v]])

meta$fvm_high_grade <- ifelse(is.na(meta$fvm_type), NA_real_,
                              as.numeric(as.character(meta$fvm_type) == "high grade"))
meta$vue_high_grade <- ifelse(is.na(meta$vue_type), NA_real_,
                              as.numeric(as.character(meta$vue_type) == "high grade"))

missing <- setdiff(c(heatmap_phenos, COVARIATES), colnames(meta))
if (length(missing) > 0) stop("Not in metadata: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

as_modelled <- function(x) {
  if (is.factor(x)) return(droplevels(x))
  u <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  if (length(u) <= 2) return(as.numeric(factor(x)) - 1)
  factor(x)
}

vif_data <- meta[, c(INFANT_ID, heatmap_phenos, COVARIATES), drop = FALSE]
for (v in c(heatmap_phenos, COVARIATES)) vif_data[[v]] <- as_modelled(vif_data[[v]])

before_s <- nrow(vif_data)
before_i <- dplyr::n_distinct(vif_data[[INFANT_ID]])
vif_data <- vif_data[stats::complete.cases(vif_data), , drop = FALSE]

cat(sprintf("Complete cases: %d of %d samples (%d of %d infants)\n",
            nrow(vif_data), before_s,
            dplyr::n_distinct(vif_data[[INFANT_ID]]), before_i))
if (nrow(vif_data) < 0.5 * before_s)
  warning("More than half the samples were dropped by complete-case filtering — ",
          "the VIFs describe a subset, and that should be stated in the methods.",
          call. = FALSE)

keep_var <- vapply(vif_data[, c(heatmap_phenos, COVARIATES), drop = FALSE],
                   function(x) length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) > 1, logical(1))
if (any(!keep_var)) {
  cat("Dropped (no variation in the complete-case subset): ",
      paste(names(keep_var)[!keep_var], collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
vif_vars <- names(keep_var)[keep_var]

run_vif <- function(dat, vars, label) {
  set.seed(1)
  dat$.y <- stats::rnorm(nrow(dat))
  form <- stats::as.formula(paste(".y ~", paste(sprintf("`%s`", vars), collapse = " + ")))
  fit  <- stats::lm(form, data = dat)

  if (any(is.na(stats::coef(fit))))
    warning(label, ": aliased (perfectly collinear) terms -> ",
            paste(names(stats::coef(fit))[is.na(stats::coef(fit))], collapse = ", "),
            call. = FALSE)

  v <- car::vif(fit)

  out <- if (is.matrix(v)) {
    tibble::tibble(Variable = rownames(v),
                   Df       = as.integer(v[, "Df"]),
                   GVIF     = round(as.numeric(v[, "GVIF"]), 3),
                   VIF_comparable = round(as.numeric(v[, ncol(v)])^2, 3))
  } else {
    tibble::tibble(Variable = names(v), Df = 1L,
                   GVIF = round(as.numeric(v), 3),
                   VIF_comparable = round(as.numeric(v), 3))
  }
  out <- out[order(-out$VIF_comparable), ]

  cat(sprintf("\n--- VIF: %s (n = %d) ---\n", label, nrow(dat)))
  print(as.data.frame(out), row.names = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("Maximum: %.2f (%s)\n", max(out$VIF_comparable),
              out$Variable[which.max(out$VIF_comparable)]))
  out$Scope <- label
  out
}

vif_sample <- run_vif(vif_data, vif_vars, "per sample")

vif_infant_data <- vif_data %>%
  group_by(.data[[INFANT_ID]]) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(vif_vars),
                   ~ if (is.numeric(.x)) mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE) else dplyr::first(.x)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame()

keep_var2 <- vapply(vif_infant_data[, vif_vars, drop = FALSE],
                    function(x) length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) > 1, logical(1))
vif_infant <- run_vif(vif_infant_data, names(keep_var2)[keep_var2], "per infant")

vif_per_model <- purrr::map_dfr(intersect(heatmap_phenos, vif_vars), function(ph) {
  vars <- c(ph, intersect(COVARIATES, vif_vars))
  dat  <- vif_data[stats::complete.cases(vif_data[, vars, drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
  if (length(unique(dat[[ph]])) < 2) return(NULL)
  set.seed(1)
  dat$.y <- stats::rnorm(nrow(dat))
  fit <- stats::lm(stats::as.formula(paste(".y ~", paste(sprintf("`%s`", vars), collapse = " + "))),
                   data = dat)
  v <- car::vif(fit)
  val <- if (is.matrix(v)) as.numeric(v[, ncol(v)])^2 else as.numeric(v)
  tibble::tibble(Model = ph, Variable = if (is.matrix(v)) rownames(v) else names(v),
                 VIF_comparable = round(val, 3))
})

cat("\n--- VIF within each fitted model (phenotype + covariates) ---\n")
vif_per_model %>%
  filter(Variable %in% heatmap_phenos) %>%
  arrange(desc(VIF_comparable)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% print(row.names = FALSE)

vif_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  vif_sample, vif_infant,
  mutate(vif_per_model, Df = 1L, GVIF = VIF_comparable,
         Scope = paste("within model:", Model)) %>% dplyr::select(-Model)
)
write.table(vif_table, "1G_VIF.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("\nMax VIF — all phenotypes jointly, per sample: %.2f | per infant: %.2f | within fitted models: %.2f\n",
            max(vif_sample$VIF_comparable), max(vif_infant$VIF_comparable),
            max(vif_per_model$VIF_comparable)))
cat("✓ Saved: 1G_VIF.txt\n")

num_vars <- vif_vars[vapply(vif_data[, vif_vars, drop = FALSE], is.numeric, logical(1))]
if (length(num_vars) > 1) {
  cm <- stats::cor(vif_data[, num_vars, drop = FALSE], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  cm[upper.tri(cm, diag = TRUE)] <- NA
  pairs <- which(!is.na(cm), arr.ind = TRUE)
  pw <- tibble::tibble(V1 = rownames(cm)[pairs[, 1]],
                       V2 = colnames(cm)[pairs[, 2]],
                       r  = round(cm[pairs], 3))
  pw <- pw[order(-abs(pw$r)), ]
  cat("\n--- Largest pairwise correlations (numeric/binary variables) ---\n")
  print(as.data.frame(head(pw, 10)), row.names = FALSE)
  write.table(pw, "1G_pairwise_correlations.txt",
              sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
}
```
